import oge

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# 读取指定范围内的多景 DEM
dem_collection = service.getCoverageCollection(
    productID="ASTER_GDEM_DEM30",
    datetime=["2000-01-01 00:00:00,2000-01-01 00:00:00"],
    bbox=[108.5, 18.1, 111.0, 20.1]
)

# 1) 多景 DEM 镶嵌，形成连续 DEM 表面
dem = service.getProcess("CoverageCollection.mosaic").execute(
    dem_collection,
    "mean"
)

# 2) 对连续 DEM 做基础平滑，抑制局部噪声
dem_base = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMean").execute(
    dem,
    "square",
    1
)

# 3) 基于处理后的 DEM 生成地形阴影结果
hillshade = service.getProcess("Coverage.terrHillshade").execute(
    dem_base,
    1,
    1
)

# 可视化参数
dem_vis = {
    "palette": ["#274e13", "#5b8a3c", "#b7b26a", "#d9c59a", "#f5f5f5"]
}

shade_vis = {
    "palette": ["#1f1f1f", "#555555", "#8a8a8a", "#c0c0c0", "#f2f2f2"]
}

# 输出结果：处理后的连续 DEM 与阴影结果对照展示
dem_base.styles(dem_vis).getMap("dem_base")
hillshade.styles(shade_vis).getMap("hillshade")

# 设置地图中心
oge.mapclient.centerMap(109.7, 19.1, 9)

import oge

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# 读取海南岛中部山区范围内的多景 DEM
dem_collection = service.getCoverageCollection(
    productID="ASTER_GDEM_DEM30",
    datetime=["2000-01-01 00:00:00,2000-01-01 00:00:00"],
    bbox=[108.5, 18.1, 111.0, 20.1]
)

# 1) 多景 DEM 镶嵌形成连续 DEM 表面
original_dem = service.getProcess("CoverageCollection.mosaic").execute(
    dem_collection,
    "mean"
)

# 可选：输出原始 DEM 的投影信息，便于确认后续分辨率参数
crs = service.getProcess("Coverage.projection").execute(original_dem)

# 2) 保留原始 DEM 作为基准版本
# original_dem 直接作为基准版本使用

# 3) 对另一份 DEM 执行平滑处理
smooth_dem = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMean").execute(
    original_dem,
    "circle",
    1
)

# 4) 基于原始 DEM 生成地形阴影结果
original_hillshade = service.getProcess("Coverage.terrHillshade").execute(
    original_dem,
    1,
    1
)

# 5) 基于处理后 DEM 生成地形阴影结果
processed_hillshade = service.getProcess("Coverage.terrHillshade").execute(
    smooth_dem,
    1,
    1
)

# 可视化参数
dem_vis = {
    "palette": ["#274e13", "#5b8a3c", "#b7b26a", "#d9c59a", "#f5f5f5"]
}

shade_vis = {
    "palette": ["#1f1f1f", "#555555", "#8a8a8a", "#c0c0c0", "#f2f2f2"]
}

# 6) 组织原始 DEM、平滑 DEM、原始阴影结果与处理后阴影结果的整体对照结构
original_dem.styles(dem_vis).getMap("original_dem")
original_hillshade.styles(shade_vis).getMap("original_hillshade")
processed_hillshade.styles(shade_vis).getMap("processed_hillshade")

# 设置地图中心
oge.mapclient.centerMap(109.7, 19.1, 9)

import oge

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# 读取单景影像
ls8 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC81220382015275LGN00",
    productID="LC08_L1T"
)


# 1) 提取目标波段（绿色波段）
target_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(ls8, ["B3"])

# 2) 对目标波段执行平滑处理
smooth_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMean").execute(
    target_band,
    "square",
    1
)

# 3) 对平滑结果执行卷积增强
kernel = service.getProcess("Kernel.prewitt").execute(True, 1.0)
enhanced_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.convolve").execute(
    smooth_band,
    kernel
)

# 4) 对增强结果做一次基础后处理
final_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMedian").execute(
    enhanced_band,
    "circle",
    1
)

# 可视化参数
vis_params = {
    "palette": ["#1f1f1f", "#5a5a5a", "#9a9a9a", "#d9d9d9", "#ffffff"]
}

# 5) 组织原始波段、平滑结果、增强结果和最终结果之间的阶段性对照关系
target_band.styles(vis_params).getMap("target_band")
smooth_band.styles(vis_params).getMap("smooth_band")
enhanced_band.styles(vis_params).getMap("enhanced_band")
final_band.styles(vis_params).getMap("final_band")


# 影像中心点位可视化
oge.mapclient.centerMap(115.74080156644999,31.7318082104,11)

import oge

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# 读取单景影像
ls8 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC81220382015275LGN00",
    productID="LC08_L1T"
)

# 1) 提取目标波段
target_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(
    ls8,
    ["B3"]
)

# 2) 构建处理支路 A：执行较弱平滑
branch_a_smooth = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMean").execute(
    target_band,
    "square",
    1
)

# 3) 在支路 A 上执行卷积增强
kernel_a = service.getProcess("Kernel.prewitt").execute(True, 1.0)
branch_a_enhanced = service.getProcess("Coverage.convolve").execute(
    branch_a_smooth,
    kernel_a
)

# 4) 构建处理支路 B：执行较强平滑
branch_b_smooth = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMean").execute(
    target_band,
    "square",
    3
)

# 5) 在支路 B 上执行卷积增强
kernel_b = service.getProcess("Kernel.laplacian4").execute()
branch_b_enhanced = service.getProcess("Coverage.convolve").execute(
    branch_b_smooth,
    kernel_b
)

# 6) 对两条支路结果分别做基础后处理
branch_a_final = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMedian").execute(
    branch_a_enhanced,
    "circle",
    1
)
branch_b_final = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMedian").execute(
    branch_b_enhanced,
    "circle",
    1
)

# 可视化参数
original_vis = {
    "min": 0,
    "max": 30000,
    "palette": ["#1f1f1f", "#5a5a5a", "#9a9a9a", "#d9d9d9", "#ffffff"]
}

enhance_vis = {
    "min": -2000,
    "max": 2000,
    "palette": ["#1f1f1f", "#5a5a5a", "#9a9a9a", "#d9d9d9", "#ffffff"]
}

# 7) 组织原始波段、支路 A 结果、支路 B 结果的对照结构
target_band.styles(original_vis).getMap("target_band")
branch_a_final.styles(enhance_vis).getMap("branch_a_final")
branch_b_final.styles(enhance_vis).getMap("branch_b_final")

# 设置地图中心
oge.mapclient.centerMap(115.74080156644999,31.7318082104,11)

)

    original_display,

    smooth_display_2,
    kernel
)

    stage_display,
    "circle",
    1
)

# 可视化参数

    "max": 2000,
    "palette": ["#1f1f1f", "#5a5a5a", "#9a9a9a", "#d9d9d9", "#ffffff"]
}

service = oge.Service()

    coverageID="LC09_L2SP_122039_20230306_20230308_02_T1",

)

original_image = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(
    lc09,
    ["SR_B4", "SR_B3", "SR_B2"]
)

# 2) 提取植被表达和水分表达所需波段
index_input = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(
    lc09,
    ["SR_B4", "SR_B5", "SR_B6"]
)

# 3) 转换为浮点型
index_input = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(index_input)

# 4) 计算植被相关指数 NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)
ndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.normalizedDifference").execute(
    index_input,
    ["SR_B5", "SR_B4"]
)

# 5) 计算水分相关指数 NDMI = (NIR - SWIR1) / (NIR + SWIR1)

    index_input,
    ["SR_B5", "SR_B6"]
)

# NDVI > 0.2
ndvi_scaled = service.getProcess("Coverage.multiplyNum").execute(ndvi, 100.0)
vegetation_mask = service.getProcess("Coverage.binarization").execute(ndvi_scaled, 20)

# 7) 从水分结果中构建偏干区域掩膜
# NDMI 偏低、更可能偏干
ndmi_inverse = service.getProcess("Coverage.multiplyNum").execute(ndmi, -100.0)
dry_mask = service.getProcess("Coverage.addNum").execute(ndmi_inverse, 10.0)
dry_mask = service.getProcess("Coverage.binarization").execute(dry_mask, 0)

dry_vegetation = service.getProcess("Coverage.multiply").execute(
    vegetation_mask,

)

    dry_vegetation,
    "square",
    1
)

    "min": -0.2,
    "max": 0.3,
    "palette": ["#8c510a", "#d8b365", "#f6e8c3", "#c7eae5", "#5ab4ac", "#01665e"]
}

dry_vis = {
    "min": 0,
    "max": 1,
    "palette": ["#f5f5f5", "#c51b7d"]
}

# 10) 组织原始影像、中间结果和最终结果的对照结构
original_image.styles(original_vis).getMap("original_image")
ndvi.styles(ndvi_vis).getMap("ndvi")
ndmi.styles(ndmi_vis).getMap("ndmi")
dry_vegetation.styles(dry_vis).getMap("dry_vegetation")

swir1_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(lc09, ["SR_B6"])
swir2_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(lc09, ["SR_B7"])

# 3) 转换为浮点型
green_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(green_band)
red_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(red_band)
nir_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(nir_band)
swir1_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(swir1_band)
swir2_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(swir2_band)

ndvi_num = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(nir_band, red_band)
ndvi_den = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(nir_band, red_band)
ndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(ndvi_num, ndvi_den)

# 5) 计算受损植被相关指数 A：NBR = (NIR - SWIR2) / (NIR + SWIR2)
nbr_num = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(nir_band, swir2_band)
nbr_den = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(nir_band, swir2_band)
nbr = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(nbr_num, nbr_den)

# 6) 计算受损植被相关指数 B：NBR2 = (SWIR1 - SWIR2) / (SWIR1 + SWIR2)
nbr2_num = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(swir1_band, swir2_band)
nbr2_den = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(swir1_band, swir2_band)
nbr2 = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(nbr2_num, nbr2_den)

mndwi_num = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(green_band, swir1_band)

non_water_mask = service.getProcess("Coverage.addNum").execute(non_water_mask, 1.0)

nbr_score = service.getProcess("Coverage.divideNum").execute(nbr_score, 2.0)

nbr2_score = service.getProcess("Coverage.divideNum").execute(nbr2_score, 2.0)

joint_degraded = service.getProcess("Coverage.binarization").execute(joint_score_scaled, 20)

}

joint_vis = {
    "min": 0,
    "max": 1,
    "palette": ["#f5f5f5", "#b2182b"]
}

)

original_image = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(
    lc09,
    ["SR_B4", "SR_B3", "SR_B2"]
)

green_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(lc09, ["SR_B3"])
red_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(lc09, ["SR_B4"])
nir_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(lc09, ["SR_B5"])
swir1_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(lc09, ["SR_B6"])
swir2_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(lc09, ["SR_B7"])

# 3) 转换为浮点型
green_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(green_band)
red_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(red_band)
nir_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(nir_band)
swir1_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(swir1_band)
swir2_band = service.getProcess("Coverage.toFloat").execute(swir2_band)

# 4) 计算植被背景指数 NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)
ndvi_num = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(nir_band, red_band)
ndvi_den = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(nir_band, red_band)
ndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(ndvi_num, ndvi_den)

# 5) 计算主提取指数 NBR = (NIR - SWIR2) / (NIR + SWIR2)
nbr_num = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(nir_band, swir2_band)
nbr_den = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(nir_band, swir2_band)
nbr = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(nbr_num, nbr_den)

# 6) 计算水体指数 MNDWI = (Green - SWIR1) / (Green + SWIR1)
mndwi_num = service.getProcess("Coverage.subtract").execute(green_band, swir1_band)
mndwi_den = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(green_band, swir1_band)
mndwi = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(mndwi_num, mndwi_den)

ndvi_scaled = service.getProcess("Coverage.multiplyNum").execute(ndvi, 100.0)
vegetation_mask = service.getProcess("Coverage.binarization").execute(ndvi_scaled, 20)

nbr_inverse = service.getProcess("Coverage.multiplyNum").execute(nbr, -100.0)
nbr_inverse = service.getProcess("Coverage.addNum").execute(nbr_inverse, 15.0)
candidate_nbr = service.getProcess("Coverage.binarization").execute(nbr_inverse, 0)

# 9) 明显水体掩膜：MNDWI > 0.10
mndwi_scaled = service.getProcess("Coverage.multiplyNum").execute(mndwi, 100.0)
water_mask = service.getProcess("Coverage.binarization").execute(mndwi_scaled, 10)

non_water_mask = service.getProcess("Coverage.multiplyNum").execute(water_mask, -1.0)
non_water_mask = service.getProcess("Coverage.addNum").execute(non_water_mask, 1.0)

    candidate_nbr,

    degraded_candidate,
    non_water_mask
)

degraded_candidate = service.getProcess("Coverage.focalMedian").execute(
    degraded_candidate,
    "square",
    1
)

# 可视化参数
original_vis = {}

nbr_vis = {
    "min": -0.2,
    "max": 0.6,
    "palette": ["#7f3b08", "#b35806", "#f1a340", "#fee0b6", "#d8daeb", "#998ec3", "#542788"]
}

candidate_vis = {
    "min": 0,
    "max": 1,
    "palette": ["#f5f5f5", "#b2182b"]
}

# 13) 组织原始影像、指数图和最终结果的对照结构
original_image.styles(original_vis).getMap("original_image")
nbr.styles(nbr_vis).getMap("nbr")
degraded_candidate.styles(candidate_vis).getMap("degraded_candidate")

# 设置地图中心

    "CoverageCollection.mosaic"
).execute(dem_collection)

# =========================
# 3. 计算坡度与坡向
# 坡度沿用 seed 1-1 中已验证更合理的 z-factor
# 坡向用于方向分组，采用 terrAspect 常规写法
# =========================

    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_mosaic, 1, 9.5e-06)

    "Coverage.terrAspect"
).execute(dem_mosaic, 1)

# 1: 平缓坡面  0-5
# 2: 缓坡      5-20
# 3: 陡坡      20-90

    (0.0, 5.0, 1.0),
    (5.0, 20.0, 2.0),
    (20.0, 90.0, 3.0)
]

slope_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 坡向方向分组
# 1: 北向坡  (0-45, 315-360)
# 2: 东向坡  (45-135)
# 3: 南向坡  (135-225)
# 4: 西向坡  (225-315)

    (0.0, 45.0, 1.0),
    (45.0, 135.0, 2.0),
    (135.0, 225.0, 3.0),
    (225.0, 315.0, 4.0),

).execute(slope_code, aspect_group)

    (32.5, 33.5, 8.0),  # 33 -> 陡南向坡
    (33.5, 34.5, 9.0)   # 34 -> 陡西向坡

import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取两景 ALOS DEM
# =========================
dem1 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="n030e110",
    productID="ALOS_PALSAR_DEM12.5"
)

    coverageID="n030e111",
    productID="ALOS_PALSAR_DEM12.5"

# 2. 合并并镶嵌

dem_collection = service.getProcess(
    "CoverageCollection.mergeCoverages"
).execute([dem1, dem2], ["dem1", "dem2"])

dem_mosaic = service.getProcess(
    "CoverageCollection.mosaic"
).execute(dem_collection)

# =========================
# 3. 计算局部起伏度（局部高差）
# 起伏度 = 邻域最大值 - 邻域最小值
# 使用 circle 核、radius=5，表达局部地形起伏强弱
# =========================
focal_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_mosaic, "circle", 9)

focal_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_mosaic, "circle", 9)

local_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(focal_max, focal_min)

# =========================
# 4. 计算粗糙度（TRI）
# band=1, computeEdges=False, options=""
# =========================
tri = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL"
).execute(dem_mosaic, 1, "False", "")

# =========================
# 5. 起伏度分级
# 1: 低起伏

#

#

    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem_mosaic, "circle", 9)

    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(dem_mosaic, dem_local_mean)

    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(relative_position, "circle", 2)

# 4. 计算坡度
# =========================
slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_mosaic, 1, 9.5e-06)

# =========================
# 5. 相对位置分型
#
# 1：谷地候选
# 2：中性位置
# 3：山脊候选
#

position_rules = [
    (-5000.0, -10.0, 1.0),
    (-10.0, 10.0, 2.0),
    (10.0, 5000.0, 3.0)

).execute(relative_position_smooth, position_rules)

#

# 21：中性位置 + 平缓
# 22：中性位置 + 坡面
# 31：山脊候选 + 平缓
# 32：山脊候选 + 坡面
# =========================
position_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(position_class, 10)

    "Coverage.add"
).execute(position_code, slope_class)

# =========================
# 8. 地貌单元归并
#

# 2：坡面带

    ]
}

slope_class.styles(slope_vis).getMap("坡度分组结果")
landform_smooth.styles(landform_vis).getMap("山脊-坡面-谷地基础粗分")

import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取单景ALOS DEM
# =========================
dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="n030e111",
    productID="ALOS_PALSAR_DEM12.5"
)

# =========================
# 2. 对DEM进行轻量平滑
# 降低12.5m DEM中的细碎噪声
# =========================
dem_base = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 3)

# =========================
# 3. 构建局部相对高程位置指标
#
# 相对位置 = 当前高程 - 较大邻域平均高程
#
# 负值表示相对低位；
# 接近0表示中间位置；
# 正值表示相对高位。
# =========================
dem_local_mean = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 15)

relative_position = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(dem_base, dem_local_mean)

relative_position_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(relative_position, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 4. 计算坡度
#
# Coverage.slope已被平台删除，
# 改用当前可用的Coverage.terrSlope。
# =========================
slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_base, 1, 9.5e-06)

# =========================
# 5. 计算局部起伏度
#
# 局部起伏 = 邻域最高高程 - 邻域最低高程
# 用于表达局部地形高差。
# =========================
focal_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)

focal_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)

relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(focal_max, focal_min)

relief_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(relief, "circle", 2)

# =========================
# 6. 相对位置分层
#
# 1：低位核心
# 2：低位过渡
# 3：中间位置
# 4：高位过渡
# 5：高位核心
# =========================
position_rules = [
    (-5000.0, -10.0, 1.0),
    (-10.0, -3.0, 2.0),
    (-3.0, 3.0, 3.0),
    (3.0, 10.0, 4.0),
    (10.0, 5000.0, 5.0)
]

position_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relative_position_smooth, position_rules)

# =========================
# 7. 坡度分组
#
# 1：较缓或非明显坡段
# 2：明显坡段
# =========================
slope_rules = [
    (0.0, 15.0, 1.0),
    (15.0, 90.0, 2.0)
]

slope_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# =========================
# 8. 局部起伏分组
#
# 1：低起伏
# 2：高起伏
# =========================
relief_rules = [
    (0.0, 40.0, 1.0),
    (40.0, 5000.0, 2.0)
]

relief_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relief_smooth, relief_rules)

# =========================
# 9. 联合编码
#
# 编码 = 相对位置类别×100
#      + 坡度类别×10
#      + 起伏类别
#
# 例如：
# 111 = 低位核心 + 较缓 + 低起伏
# 222 = 低位过渡 + 明显坡段 + 高起伏
# 422 = 高位过渡 + 明显坡段 + 高起伏
# 511 = 高位核心 + 较缓 + 低起伏
# =========================
position_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(position_class, 100)

slope_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(slope_class, 10)

tmp_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(position_code, slope_code)

combined_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_code, relief_class)

# =========================
# 10. 地形结构分区
#
# 1：谷地控制带
# 2：侧坡连接带
# 3：山脊控制带
#
# 规则：
# - 低位核心全部归入谷地控制带；
# - 低位过渡中的明显坡段、高起伏区
#   作为谷地控制带延伸；
# - 高位核心全部归入山脊控制带；
# - 高位过渡中的明显坡段、高起伏区
#   作为山脊控制带延伸；
# - 其余区域归入侧坡连接带。
# =========================
structure_rules = [
    # 低位核心：111、112、121、122
    (110.5, 122.5, 1.0),

    # 低位核心至低位过渡之间的其他组合
    (122.5, 221.5, 2.0),

    # 低位过渡 + 明显坡段 + 高起伏：222
    (221.5, 222.5, 1.0),

    # 中部主体以及高位过渡的其他组合
    (222.5, 421.5, 2.0),

    # 高位过渡 + 明显坡段 + 高起伏：422
    (421.5, 422.5, 3.0),

    # 高位过渡至高位核心之间的其他组合
    (422.5, 510.5, 2.0),

    # 高位核心：511、512、521、522
    (510.5, 522.5, 3.0)
]

structure_band = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(combined_code, structure_rules)

# =========================
# 11. 轻量去碎斑
# =========================
structure_band_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMode"
).execute(structure_band, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 12. 可视化
# =========================
position_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 5,
    "palette": [
        "#2b83ba",  # 低位核心
        "#91bfdb",  # 低位过渡
        "#ffffbf",  # 中间位置
        "#fdae61",  # 高位过渡
        "#d7191c"   # 高位核心
    ]
}

slope_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 2,
    "palette": [
        "#d9f0d3",  # 较缓
        "#f46d43"   # 明显坡段
    ]
}

relief_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 2,
    "palette": [
        "#ffffcc",  # 低起伏
        "#8c2d04"   # 高起伏
    ]
}

structure_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#2b83ba",  # 谷地控制带
        "#fdae61",  # 侧坡连接带
        "#d7191c"   # 山脊控制带
    ]
}

position_class.styles(
    position_vis
).getMap("相对高程位置分层结果")

slope_class.styles(
    slope_vis
).getMap("坡度分组结果")

relief_class.styles(
    relief_vis
).getMap("局部起伏分组结果")

structure_band_smooth.styles(
    structure_vis
).getMap("山脊-谷地-侧坡结构分区结果")

oge.mapclient.centerMap(111.5, 30.5, 10)

# 8. 局部起伏分组
#
# 1：低起伏
# 2：高起伏
# =========================
relief_rules = [
    (0.0, 40.0, 1.0),
    (40.0, 5000.0, 2.0)
]

relief_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relief_smooth, relief_rules)

# =========================
# 9. 联合编码
#
# 编码 = 相对位置类别×100
#      + 坡度类别×10
#      + 起伏类别
#
# 例如：
# 111 = 低位核心 + 较缓 + 低起伏
# 222 = 低位过渡 + 明显坡段 + 高起伏
# 422 = 高位过渡 + 明显坡段 + 高起伏
# 511 = 高位核心 + 较缓 + 低起伏
# =========================
position_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(position_class, 100)

slope_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(slope_class, 10)

tmp_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(position_code, slope_code)

combined_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_code, relief_class)

# =========================
# 10. 地形结构分区
#
# 1：谷地控制带
# 2：侧坡连接带
# 3：山脊控制带
#
# 规则：
# - 低位核心全部归入谷地控制带；
# - 低位过渡中的明显坡段、高起伏区
#   作为谷地控制带延伸；
# - 高位核心全部归入山脊控制带；
# - 高位过渡中的明显坡段、高起伏区
#   作为山脊控制带延伸；
# - 其余区域归入侧坡连接带。
# =========================
structure_rules = [
    # 低位核心：111、112、121、122
    (110.5, 122.5, 1.0),

    # 低位核心至低位过渡之间的其他组合
    (122.5, 221.5, 2.0),

    # 低位过渡 + 明显坡段 + 高起伏：222
    (221.5, 222.5, 1.0),

    # 中部主体以及高位过渡的其他组合
    (222.5, 421.5, 2.0),

    # 高位过渡 + 明显坡段 + 高起伏：422
    (421.5, 422.5, 3.0),

    # 高位过渡至高位核心之间的其他组合
    (422.5, 510.5, 2.0),

    # 高位核心：511、512、521、522
    (510.5, 522.5, 3.0)
]

structure_band = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(combined_code, structure_rules)

# =========================
# 11. 轻量去碎斑
# =========================
structure_band_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMode"
).execute(structure_band, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 12. 可视化
# =========================
position_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 5,
    "palette": [
        "#2b83ba",  # 低位核心
        "#91bfdb",  # 低位过渡
        "#ffffbf",  # 中间位置
        "#fdae61",  # 高位过渡

        "#fdae61",  # 侧坡连接带

import oge

# =========================
oge.initialize()

# 1. 读取单景 ASTER DEM

dem = service.getCoverage(

)

# 降低局部噪声，便于多尺度起伏比较

).execute(dem, "circle", 1)

# 3. 分别计算小/中/大尺度局部起伏
# 起伏 = 邻域最大值 - 邻域最小值
# 这里采用较稳的 2 / 5 / 9 三个尺度
# =========================

small_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 2)
small_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 2)
small_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(small_max, small_min)

# 中尺度
medium_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 5)
medium_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 5)
medium_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(medium_max, medium_min)

# 大尺度
large_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)
large_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)
large_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(large_max, large_min)

# =========================
# 4. 对三组起伏结果分别分级
# 1 = 低起伏
# 2 = 中起伏
# 3 = 高起伏
# 这组阈值适配 ASTGTM_N32E109 这种
# 同时存在较强山地与相对缓和区域的场景
# =========================
small_rules = [
    (0.0, 10.0, 1.0),
    (10.0, 25.0, 2.0),
    (25.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

medium_rules = [
    (0.0, 30.0, 1.0),
    (30.0, 80.0, 2.0),
    (80.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

large_rules = [
    (0.0, 80.0, 1.0),
    (80.0, 180.0, 2.0),
    (180.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

small_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(small_relief, small_rules)

medium_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(medium_relief, medium_rules)

large_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(large_relief, large_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 在每个尺度下提取高起伏候选区
# 0 = 非高起伏
# 1 = 高起伏
# =========================
high_rules = [
    (-0.5, 2.5, 0.0),
    (2.5, 3.5, 1.0)
]

small_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(small_class, high_rules)

medium_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(medium_class, high_rules)

large_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(large_class, high_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 统计三个尺度中“高起伏”出现的次数
# high_count = 0,1,2,3
# =========================
tmp_count = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(small_high, medium_high)

high_count = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_count, large_high)

# =========================
# 7. 稳定性分区
# 1 = 一般区（0个尺度高起伏）
# 2 = 尺度敏感区（仅1个尺度高起伏）
# 3 = 稳定高起伏区（2个及以上尺度高起伏）
# =========================
stability_rules = [
    (-0.5, 0.5, 1.0),   # 0 -> 一般区
    (0.5, 1.5, 2.0),    # 1 -> 尺度敏感区
    (1.5, 3.5, 3.0)     # 2,3 -> 稳定高起伏区
]

stability = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(high_count, stability_rules)

# =========================
# 8. 轻量去碎斑
# 仅对最终结果做一次邻域众数整理
# =========================
stability_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMode"
).execute(stability, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 9. 可视化
# =========================
relief_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#edf8fb",  # 低起伏
        "#9ecae1",  # 中起伏
        "#08519c"   # 高起伏
    ]
}

stability_vis = {

    "max": 3,

        "#fdae61",  # 尺度敏感区
        "#d73027"   # 稳定高起伏区
    ]
}

small_class.styles(relief_vis).getMap("小尺度起伏结果")

large_class.styles(relief_vis).getMap("大尺度起伏结果")

import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取单景 ALOS DEM
# =========================
dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="n030e111",
    productID="ALOS_PALSAR_DEM12.5"
)



# =========================
# 2. 构建小/中/大尺度 DEM
# 思路：先对 DEM 做不同尺度平滑，再分别计算 TRI
# 这样 TRI 本身仍是局部崎岖度，但其作用尺度不同
# =========================
# 小尺度：基本保持原始地形细节
dem_small = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 1)

# 中尺度：适度平滑
dem_medium = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 3)

# 大尺度：更强平滑
dem_large = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 7)

# =========================
# 3. 分别计算小/中/大尺度粗糙度（TRI）
# =========================
tri_small = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL"
).execute(dem_small, 1, "False", "")

tri_medium = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL"
).execute(dem_medium, 1, "False", "")

tri_large = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL"
).execute(dem_large, 1, "False", "")

# =========================
# 4. 对三组粗糙度结果分别分级
# 1 = 低粗糙
# 2 = 中粗糙
# 3 = 高粗糙
#
# 大尺度 DEM 已经过平滑，因此 TRI 阈值随尺度变大而降低
# =========================
small_rules = [
    (0.0, 8.0, 1.0),
    (8.0, 20.0, 2.0),
    (20.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

medium_rules = [
    (0.0, 5.0, 1.0),
    (5.0, 12.0, 2.0),
    (12.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

large_rules = [
    (0.0, 3.0, 1.0),
    (3.0, 8.0, 2.0),
    (8.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

tri_small_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_small, small_rules)

tri_medium_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_medium, medium_rules)

tri_large_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_large, large_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 各尺度高粗糙候选区提取
# 0 = 非高粗糙
# 1 = 高粗糙
# =========================
high_rules = [
    (-0.5, 2.5, 0.0),
    (2.5, 3.5, 1.0)
]

small_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_small_class, high_rules)

medium_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_medium_class, high_rules)

large_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_large_class, high_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 统计高粗糙出现次数
# high_count = 0,1,2,3
# 同时计算三尺度等级总和（3~9）
# =========================
tmp_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(small_high, medium_high)

high_count = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_high, large_high)

tmp_sum = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tri_small_class, tri_medium_class)

roughness_sum = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_sum, tri_large_class)

# =========================
# 7. 构建综合复杂度分数
# combined_score = high_count * 10 + roughness_sum
#
# 设计思想：
# - 多尺度高粗糙出现次数越多，复杂度越高
# - 即便没有达到“高粗糙”，如果三个尺度总和偏高，也可进入中复杂度
# =========================
high_count_x10 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(high_count, 10)

combined_score = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(high_count_x10, roughness_sum)

# =========================
# 8. 归并为综合复杂度等级
# 1 = 低复杂度
# 2 = 中复杂度
# 3 = 高复杂度
#
# 规则解释：
# - high_count = 0，且总和较低 -> 低复杂度
# - high_count = 0，但总和偏高；或 high_count = 1 -> 中复杂度
# - high_count >= 2 -> 高复杂度
# =========================
complexity_rules = [
    (-0.5, 4.5, 1.0),    # 3,4 -> 低复杂度
    (4.5, 6.5, 2.0),     # 5,6 -> 中复杂度
    (14.5, 19.5, 2.0),   # 15~19 -> 单尺度高粗糙，判为中复杂度
    (24.5, 39.5, 3.0)    # 25~39 -> 多尺度高粗糙，判为高复杂度
]

complexity = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(combined_score, complexity_rules)

# =========================
# 9. 轻量去碎斑
# =========================
complexity_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMode"
).execute(complexity, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 10. 可视化
# =========================
roughness_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#edf8fb",  # 低粗糙
        "#9ecae1",  # 中粗糙
        "#08519c"   # 高粗糙
    ]
}

complexity_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#d9d9d9",  # 低复杂度
        "#fdae61",  # 中复杂度
        "#d73027"   # 高复杂度
    ]
}

tri_small_class.styles(roughness_vis).getMap("小尺度粗糙度结果")
tri_medium_class.styles(roughness_vis).getMap("中尺度粗糙度结果")
tri_large_class.styles(roughness_vis).getMap("大尺度粗糙度结果")
complexity_smooth.styles(complexity_vis).getMap("综合复杂度等级结果")

# 小尺度：基本保持原始地形细节
dem_small = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 1)

# 中尺度：适度平滑
dem_medium = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 3)

# 大尺度：更强平滑
dem_large = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 7)

# =========================
# 3. 分别计算小/中/大尺度粗糙度（TRI）
# =========================
tri_small = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL"
).execute(dem_small, 1, "False", "")

tri_medium = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL"
).execute(dem_medium, 1, "False", "")

tri_large = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL"
).execute(dem_large, 1, "False", "")

# =========================
# 4. 对三组粗糙度结果分别分级
# 1 = 低粗糙
# 2 = 中粗糙
# 3 = 高粗糙
#
# 大尺度 DEM 已经过平滑，因此 TRI 阈值随尺度变大而降低
# =========================
small_rules = [
    (0.0, 8.0, 1.0),
    (8.0, 20.0, 2.0),
    (20.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

medium_rules = [
    (0.0, 5.0, 1.0),
    (5.0, 12.0, 2.0),
    (12.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

large_rules = [
    (0.0, 3.0, 1.0),
    (3.0, 8.0, 2.0),
    (8.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

tri_small_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_small, small_rules)

tri_medium_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_medium, medium_rules)

tri_large_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_large, large_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 各尺度高粗糙候选区提取
# 0 = 非高粗糙
# 1 = 高粗糙
# =========================
high_rules = [
    (-0.5, 2.5, 0.0),
    (2.5, 3.5, 1.0)
]

small_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_small_class, high_rules)

medium_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_medium_class, high_rules)

large_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri_large_class, high_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 统计高粗糙出现次数
# high_count = 0,1,2,3
# 同时计算三尺度等级总和（3~9）
# =========================
tmp_high = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(small_high, medium_high)

high_count = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_high, large_high)

tmp_sum = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tri_small_class, tri_medium_class)

roughness_sum = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_sum, tri_large_class)

# =========================
# 7. 构建综合复杂度分数
# combined_score = high_count * 10 + roughness_sum
#
# 设计思想：
# - 多尺度高粗糙出现次数越多，复杂度越高
# - 即便没有达到“高粗糙”，如果三个尺度总和偏高，也可进入中复杂度
# =========================
high_count_x10 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(high_count, 10)

combined_score = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(high_count_x10, roughness_sum)

# =========================
# 8. 归并为综合复杂度等级
# 1 = 低复杂度
# 2 = 中复杂度
# 3 = 高复杂度
#
# 规则解释：
# - high_count = 0，且总和较低 -> 低复杂度
# - high_count = 0，但总和偏高；或 high_count = 1 -> 中复杂度
# - high_count >= 2 -> 高复杂度
# =========================
complexity_rules = [
    (-0.5, 4.5, 1.0),    # 3,4 -> 低复杂度
    (4.5, 6.5, 2.0),     # 5,6 -> 中复杂度
    (14.5, 19.5, 2.0),   # 15~19 -> 单尺度高粗糙，判为中复杂度
    (24.5, 39.5, 3.0)    # 25~39 -> 多尺度高粗糙，判为高复杂度
]

complexity = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(combined_score, complexity_rules)

# =========================
# 9. 轻量去碎斑
# =========================
complexity_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMode"
).execute(complexity, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 10. 可视化
# =========================
roughness_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#edf8fb",  # 低粗糙
        "#9ecae1",  # 中粗糙
        "#08519c"   # 高粗糙
    ]
}

complexity_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#d9d9d9",  # 低复杂度
        "#fdae61",  # 中复杂度
        "#d73027"   # 高复杂度
    ]
}

tri_small_class.styles(roughness_vis).getMap("小尺度粗糙度结果")
tri_medium_class.styles(roughness_vis).getMap("中尺度粗糙度结果")
tri_large_class.styles(roughness_vis).getMap("大尺度粗糙度结果")
complexity_smooth.styles(complexity_vis).getMap("综合复杂度等级结果")

import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取单景 ASTER DEM
# =========================
dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="ASTGTM_N32E111",
    productID="ASTER_GDEM_DEM30"
)

NaN_value = -9999

# =========================
# 2. DEM 轻量平滑
# 降低局部噪声，便于多尺度比较
# =========================
dem_base = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 3. 计算小/中/大尺度起伏
# 起伏 = 邻域最大值 - 邻域最小值
# =========================
# 小尺度
small_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 2)
small_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 2)
small_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(small_max, small_min)

# 中尺度
medium_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 5)
medium_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 5)
medium_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(medium_max, medium_min)

# 大尺度
large_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)
large_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)
large_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(large_max, large_min)

# =========================
# 4. 多尺度起伏等级统一分级
# 1 = 低起伏
# 2 = 中起伏
# 3 = 高起伏
# =========================
small_rules = [
    (0.0, 10.0, 1.0),
    (10.0, 25.0, 2.0),
    (25.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

medium_rules = [
    (0.0, 30.0, 1.0),
    (30.0, 80.0, 2.0),
    (80.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

large_rules = [
    (0.0, 80.0, 1.0),
    (80.0, 180.0, 2.0),
    (180.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

small_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(small_relief, small_rules)

medium_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(medium_relief, medium_rules)

large_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(large_relief, large_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 联合编码
# code = 小尺度*100 + 中尺度*10 + 大尺度
# 例如：
# 111 = 三尺度都为低起伏
# 222 = 三尺度都为中起伏
# 333 = 三尺度都为高起伏
# 123 = 三尺度全不同
# =========================
small_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(small_class, 100)

medium_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(medium_class, 10)

tmp_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(small_code, medium_code)

combined_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_code, large_class)

# =========================
# 6. 一致性 / 分歧规则
# 1 = 稳定低起伏带
# 2 = 稳定中起伏带
# 3 = 稳定高起伏带
# 4 = 尺度分歧带
# 5 = 一般过渡区
#
# 规则设计：
# - 111/222/333：三尺度完全一致，视为结构稳定带
# - 同时包含 1 和 3，或三个尺度全不同：视为尺度分歧带
# - 其余只在相邻等级间变化的：视为一般过渡区
# =========================
consistency_rules = [
    # -------------------------
    # 1 = 稳定低起伏带（低起伏占主导）
    # -------------------------
    (110.5, 111.5, 1.0),  # 111
    (111.5, 112.5, 1.0),  # 112
    (120.5, 121.5, 1.0),  # 121
    (210.5, 211.5, 1.0),  # 211

    # -------------------------
    # 2 = 稳定中起伏带（中起伏占主导）
    # -------------------------
    (121.5, 122.5, 2.0),  # 122
    (211.5, 212.5, 2.0),  # 212
    (220.5, 221.5, 2.0),  # 221
    (221.5, 222.5, 2.0),  # 222
    (222.5, 223.5, 2.0),  # 223
    (231.5, 232.5, 2.0),  # 232
    (321.5, 322.5, 2.0),  # 322

    # -------------------------
    # 3 = 稳定高起伏带（高起伏占主导）
    # -------------------------
    (232.5, 233.5, 3.0),  # 233
    (322.5, 323.5, 3.0),  # 323
    (331.5, 332.5, 3.0),  # 332
    (332.5, 333.5, 3.0),  # 333

    # -------------------------
    # 4 = 尺度分歧带
    # 条件：同时出现 1 和 3，或三个尺度全不同
    # -------------------------
    (112.5, 113.5, 4.0),  # 113
    (122.5, 123.5, 4.0),  # 123
    (130.5, 131.5, 4.0),  # 131
    (131.5, 132.5, 4.0),  # 132
    (132.5, 133.5, 4.0),  # 133
    (212.5, 213.5, 4.0),  # 213
    (230.5, 231.5, 4.0),  # 231
    (310.5, 311.5, 4.0),  # 311
    (311.5, 312.5, 4.0),  # 312
    (312.5, 313.5, 4.0),  # 313
    (320.5, 321.5, 4.0),  # 321
    (330.5, 331.5, 4.0)   # 331
]

consistency = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(combined_code, consistency_rules)

# =========================
# 7. 可视化
# =========================
relief_vis = {
    "min": 1,

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取单景 ASTER DEM
# =========================
dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="ASTGTM_N32E111",
    productID="ASTER_GDEM_DEM30"
)

NaN_value = -9999

# =========================
# 2. DEM 轻量平滑
# 降低局部噪声，便于多尺度比较
# =========================
dem_base = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 3. 计算小/中/大尺度起伏
# 起伏 = 邻域最大值 - 邻域最小值
# =========================
# 小尺度
small_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 2)
small_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 2)
small_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(small_max, small_min)

# 中尺度
medium_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 5)
medium_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 5)
medium_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(medium_max, medium_min)

# 大尺度
large_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)
large_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)
large_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(large_max, large_min)

# =========================
# 4. 多尺度起伏等级统一分级
# 1 = 低起伏
# 2 = 中起伏
# 3 = 高起伏
# =========================
small_rules = [
    (0.0, 10.0, 1.0),
    (10.0, 25.0, 2.0),
    (25.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

medium_rules = [
    (0.0, 30.0, 1.0),
    (30.0, 80.0, 2.0),
    (80.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

large_rules = [
    (0.0, 80.0, 1.0),
    (80.0, 180.0, 2.0),
    (180.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

small_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(small_relief, small_rules)

medium_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(medium_relief, medium_rules)

large_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(large_relief, large_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 联合编码
# code = 小尺度*100 + 中尺度*10 + 大尺度
# 例如：
# 111 = 三尺度都为低起伏
# 222 = 三尺度都为中起伏
# 333 = 三尺度都为高起伏
# 123 = 三尺度全不同

    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(small_class, 100)

).execute(medium_class, 10)

).execute(small_code, medium_code)

combined_code = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"

# 2 = 稳定中起伏带
# 3 = 稳定高起伏带

# - 111/222/333：三尺度完全一致，视为结构稳定带
# - 同时包含 1 和 3，或三个尺度全不同：视为尺度分歧带
# - 其余只在相邻等级间变化的：视为一般过渡区

    (110.5, 111.5, 1.0),  # 111

    (210.5, 211.5, 1.0),  # 211

    (121.5, 122.5, 2.0),  # 122
    (211.5, 212.5, 2.0),  # 212
    (220.5, 221.5, 2.0),  # 221
    (221.5, 222.5, 2.0),  # 222
    (222.5, 223.5, 2.0),  # 223
    (231.5, 232.5, 2.0),  # 232
    (321.5, 322.5, 2.0),  # 322

    # -------------------------
    # 3 = 稳定高起伏带（高起伏占主导）
    # -------------------------
    (232.5, 233.5, 3.0),  # 233
    (322.5, 323.5, 3.0),  # 323
    (331.5, 332.5, 3.0),  # 332
    (332.5, 333.5, 3.0),  # 333

    # -------------------------
    # 4 = 尺度分歧带
    # 条件：同时出现 1 和 3，或三个尺度全不同
    # -------------------------
    (112.5, 113.5, 4.0),  # 113
    (122.5, 123.5, 4.0),  # 123
    (130.5, 131.5, 4.0),  # 131
    (131.5, 132.5, 4.0),  # 132
    (132.5, 133.5, 4.0),  # 133
    (212.5, 213.5, 4.0),  # 213

    (310.5, 311.5, 4.0),  # 311

    (312.5, 313.5, 4.0),  # 313
    (320.5, 321.5, 4.0),  # 321
    (330.5, 331.5, 4.0)   # 331

import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# 建议使用 initialize() 确保算子正确加载
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service.initialize()

# =========================
# 1. 读取单景 ASTER DEM
# =========================
dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="ASTGTM_N30E115",
    productID="ASTER_GDEM_DEM30"
)

# =========================
# 2. DEM 轻量平滑
# 既保留区域地形结构，又减少局部噪声
# =========================
dem_base = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 2)

# =========================
# 3. 坡度
# 用于识别明显不利的陡坡区域
# =========================
slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_base, 1, 9.5e-06)

# 坡度等级：
# 1 = 条件较优
# 2 = 一般
# 3 = 不利
slope_rules = [
    (0.0, 8.0, 1.0),
    (8.0, 18.0, 2.0),
    (18.0, 90.0, 3.0)
]

# 修复：移除多余的 NaN_value 参数
slope_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# =========================
# 4. 局部起伏（局部高差）
# 用于识别起伏过强区域
# =========================
focal_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)

focal_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)

relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(focal_max, focal_min)

relief_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(relief, "circle", 2)

# 起伏等级：
# 1 = 条件较优
# 2 = 一般
# 3 = 不利
relief_rules = [
    (0.0, 40.0, 1.0),
    (40.0, 100.0, 2.0),
    (100.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

# 修复：移除多余的 NaN_value 参数
relief_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relief_smooth, relief_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 粗糙度（TRI）
# 用于识别表面过碎区域
# =========================
dem_tri = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 1)

tri = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL"
).execute(dem_tri, 1, "False", "")

# 粗糙度等级：
# 1 = 条件较优
# 2 = 一般
# 3 = 不利
tri_rules = [
    (0.0, 5.0, 1.0),
    (5.0, 12.0, 2.0),
    (12.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

# 修复：移除多余的 NaN_value 参数
tri_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(tri, tri_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 三因子约束综合
# score = 坡度等级 + 起伏等级 + 粗糙度等级
# 最小 3，最大 9
# =========================
tmp_score = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(slope_class, relief_class)

constraint_score = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_score, tri_class)

# =========================
# 7. 最终初筛结果
# 1 = 基础候选区
# 2 = 一般区
# 3 = 地形不利区
# =========================
candidate_rules = [
    (2.5, 4.5, 1.0),  # 对应总分 3, 4
    (4.5, 6.5, 2.0),  # 对应总分 5, 6
    (6.5, 9.5, 3.0)   # 对应总分 7, 8, 9
]

# 修复：移除多余的 NaN_value 参数
candidate_zone = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(constraint_score, candidate_rules)

# =========================
# 8. 轻量归并与去碎斑
# 只做一次轻量整理，避免小斑块过多
# =========================
candidate_zone_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMode"
).execute(candidate_zone, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 9. 可视化
# =========================
slope_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#d9f0d3",  # 条件较优
        "#fdae61",  # 一般
        "#d73027"   # 不利
    ]
}

relief_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#edf8fb",  # 条件较优
        "#9ecae1",  # 一般
        "#08519c"   # 不利
    ]
}

candidate_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#2ca25f",  # 基础候选区
        "#fdae61",  # 一般区
        "#d73027"   # 地形不利区
    ]
}

relief_class.styles(relief_vis).getMap("起伏约束等级结果")
candidate_zone_smooth.styles(candidate_vis).getMap("基础候选区初筛结果")

import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取单景 ALOS DEM
# =========================
dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="n030e111",
    productID="ALOS_PALSAR_DEM12.5"
)

NaN_value = -9999

# =========================
# 2. 基础 DEM
# 轻量平滑，减少 12.5m DEM 的细碎噪声
# =========================
dem_base = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem, "circle", 3)

# =========================
# 3. 坡度
# 用于识别明显陡坡阻隔区
# =========================
slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_base, 5, 9.5e-06)

# 坡度分级：
# 1 = 缓坡（更友好）
# 2 = 中等坡（受限）
# 3 = 陡坡（高阻隔）
slope_rules = [
    (0.0, 10.0, 1.0),
    (10.0, 20.0, 2.0),
    (20.0, 90.0, 3.0)
]

slope_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# =========================
# 4. 相对高程位置
# 相对位置 = 当前高程 - 较大邻域平均高程
# 用于识别谷地、低位坡脚和一般坡面
# =========================
dem_local_mean = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 15)

relative_position = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(dem_base, dem_local_mean)

relative_position_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(relative_position, "circle", 1)

# 地形位置分级：
# 1 = 谷地/低位核心
# 2 = 低位过渡/坡脚
# 3 = 一般坡面及更高位置
position_rules = [
    (-5000.0, -15.0, 1.0),
    (-15.0, -5.0, 2.0),
    (-5.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

position_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relative_position_smooth, position_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 局部起伏
# 用于识别通行连续性较差的起伏扰动区
# =========================
focal_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)

focal_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_base, "circle", 9)

relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(focal_max, focal_min)

relief_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(relief, "circle", 2)

# 起伏分级：
# 1 = 低起伏（更连续）
# 2 = 中起伏（受限）
# 3 = 高起伏（阻隔）
relief_rules = [
    (0.0, 40.0, 1.0),
    (40.0, 100.0, 2.0),
    (100.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

relief_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relief_smooth, relief_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 通行友好性综合评分
# 位置越低越有利，坡度和起伏权重更高
#
# score = position + 2*slope + 2*relief
#
# 解释：
# - 低位 + 缓坡 + 低起伏 -> 分数低，趋向友好通行带
# - 中间状态 -> 受限过渡带
# - 陡坡或高起伏主导 -> 高阻隔地形区
# =========================
slope_weight = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(slope_class, 2)

relief_weight = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(relief_class, 2)

).execute(dem_base, 5, 9.5e-06)

    (10.0, 20.0, 2.0),
    (20.0, 90.0, 3.0)
]

).execute(slope, slope_rules)

import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取光学影像与 DEM
# =========================
landsat = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC81270372016169LGN00",
    productID="LC08_L1T"
)

dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="ASTGTM_N33E108",
    productID="ASTER_GDEM_DEM30"
)

# 沿用你前面旧案例里可运行的 geoDetector / reclass 写法
NaN_value = 0

# =========================
# 2. 构建 NDVI（被解释对象）
# 先转 double，再做 NDVI，并缩放到 -100 ~ 100 左右
# Landsat 8: NIR=B5, Red=B4
# =========================
landsat_double = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.toDouble"
).execute(landsat)

ndvi = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.normalizedDifference"
).execute(landsat_double, ["B5", "B4"])

ndvi_scaled = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(ndvi, 100.0)

# =========================


# 3. 统一NDVI和DEM的空间参考及分辨率
# Coverage.rasterUnion已被删除
# =========================
ndvi_clip = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reproject"
).execute(ndvi_scaled, 3857, 30)

dem_clip = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reproject"
).execute(dem, 3857, 30)

# =========================
# 4. 派生地形因子
# EPSG:3857为米制坐标，因此z-factor使用1.0
# =========================
slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_clip, 1, 1.0)

aspect = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrAspect"
).execute(dem_clip, 1)

# 局部起伏 = 邻域最大值 - 邻域最小值
focal_max = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMax"
).execute(dem_clip, "circle", 5)

focal_min = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMin"
).execute(dem_clip, "circle", 5)

relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(focal_max, focal_min)

# =========================
# 5. 各地形因子离散化
# 形成可比较的分类体系
# =========================

# 高程分层
dem_rules = [
    (0.0, 1000.0, 1.0),
    (1000.0, 1500.0, 2.0),
    (1500.0, 2000.0, 3.0),
    (2000.0, 2500.0, 4.0),
    (2500.0, 5000.0, 5.0)
]
dem_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(dem_clip, dem_rules)

# 坡度分层
slope_rules = [
    (0.0, 5.0, 1.0),
    (5.0, 15.0, 2.0),
    (15.0, 25.0, 3.0),
    (25.0, 35.0, 4.0),
    (35.0, 90.0, 5.0)
]
slope_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# 坡向分组（北/东/南/西）
aspect_rules = [
    (0.0, 45.0, 1.0),
    (45.0, 135.0, 2.0),
    (135.0, 225.0, 3.0),
    (225.0, 315.0, 4.0),
    (315.0, 361.0, 1.0)
]
aspect_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(aspect, aspect_rules)

# 局部起伏分层
relief_rules = [
    (0.0, 50.0, 1.0),
    (50.0, 100.0, 2.0),
    (100.0, 200.0, 3.0),
    (200.0, 350.0, 4.0),
    (350.0, 5000.0, 5.0)
]
relief_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relief, relief_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 植被状态分布结果（用于展示）
# 对 NDVI 做分层显示
# =========================
ndvi_rules = [
    (-100.0, 0.0, 1.0),
    (0.0, 20.0, 2.0),
    (20.0, 40.0, 3.0),
    (40.0, 60.0, 4.0),
    (60.0, 100.0, 5.0)
]
ndvi_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(ndvi_clip, ndvi_rules)

# =========================
# 7. 各地形因子解释力评估
# 按你前面旧案例的 geoDetector 调用方式
# 因变量正常范围控制为 -100 ~ 100
# =========================
ndvi_min = -100.0
ndvi_max = 100.0

geo_res_dem = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndvi_clip,
    "elevation",
    dem_class,
    ndvi_min,
    ndvi_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndvi_clip,
    "slope",
    slope_class,
    ndvi_min,
    ndvi_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_aspect = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndvi_clip,
    "aspect",
    aspect_class,
    ndvi_min,
    ndvi_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_relief = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndvi_clip,
    "relief",
    relief_class,
    ndvi_min,
    ndvi_max,
    NaN_value
)

# =========================
# 8. 结果展示与控制台输出
# 说明：
# 最终以 q 值最高者判定为主导地形因子，
# 次高者可视为次主导因子
# =========================
ndvi_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 5,
    "palette": [
        "#f7fcf5",
        "#c7e9c0",
        "#74c476",
        "#31a354",
        "#006d2c"
    ]
}

ndvi_class.styles(ndvi_vis).getMap("植被状态分布结果")

geo_res_dem.log("高程因子解释结果")
geo_res_slope.log("坡度因子解释结果")
geo_res_aspect.log("坡向因子解释结果")
geo_res_relief.log("局部起伏因子解释结果")

oge.mapclient.centerMap(108.43, 33.17, 10)

import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取冬季光学影像与 DEM
# =========================
landsat = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC09_L2SP_115028_20230116_20230313_02_T1",
    productID="LC09_C02_L2"
)

dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="ASTGTM_N45E130",
    productID="ASTER_GDEM_DEM30"
)

NaN_value = 0

# =========================
# 2. 提取 Green / SWIR1 波段并计算 NDSI
# Landsat 9 L2:
# Green = SR_B3
# SWIR1 = SR_B6
#
# 按 Collection 2 Level-2 SR 的常用缩放：
# reflectance = DN * 0.0000275 - 0.2
# =========================
green = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(landsat, ["SR_B3"])

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(landsat, ["SR_B6"])

green = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.toDouble"
).execute(green)

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.toDouble"
).execute(swir1)

green = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(green, 0.0000275)

green = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(green, -0.2)

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(swir1, 0.0000275)

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(swir1, -0.2)

ndsi_num = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(green, swir1)

ndsi_den = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(green, swir1)

ndsi = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.divide"
).execute(ndsi_num, ndsi_den)

# 缩放到 -100 ~ 100，便于后续分层和 geoDetector
ndsi_scaled = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(ndsi, 100.0)

# =========================
# 3. 对齐 DEM 与 NDSI 的重叠区域
# =========================
ndsi_clip = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reproject"
).execute(ndsi_scaled, 3857, 30)

dem_clip = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reproject"
).execute(dem, 3857, 30)

# =========================
# 4. 派生地形因子
# - 高程
# - 坡度
# - 坡向
# - 相对地形位置
# =========================
# EPSG:3857为米制坐标，z-factor使用1.0
slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_clip, 1, 1.0)

aspect = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrAspect"
).execute(dem_clip, 1)

dem_local_mean = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem_clip, "circle", 9)

relative_position = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(dem_clip, dem_local_mean)

relative_position_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(relative_position, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 5. 各地形因子离散化
# =========================

# 高程分层
dem_rules = [
    (0.0, 300.0, 1.0),
    (300.0, 500.0, 2.0),
    (500.0, 700.0, 3.0),
    (700.0, 900.0, 4.0),
    (900.0, 5000.0, 5.0)
]
dem_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(dem_clip, dem_rules)

# 坡度分层
slope_rules = [
    (0.0, 5.0, 1.0),
    (5.0, 15.0, 2.0),
    (15.0, 25.0, 3.0),
    (25.0, 35.0, 4.0),
    (35.0, 90.0, 5.0)
]
slope_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# 坡向分组（北 / 东 / 南 / 西）
aspect_rules = [
    (0.0, 45.0, 1.0),
    (45.0, 135.0, 2.0),
    (135.0, 225.0, 3.0),
    (225.0, 315.0, 4.0),
    (315.0, 361.0, 1.0)
]
aspect_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(aspect, aspect_rules)

# 相对地形位置分层
position_rules = [
    (-5000.0, -20.0, 1.0),
    (-20.0, -5.0, 2.0),
    (-5.0, 5.0, 3.0),
    (5.0, 20.0, 4.0),
    (20.0, 5000.0, 5.0)
]
position_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relative_position_smooth, position_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 积雪结果分层
# 这里用 NDSI 表达：
# 1 = 弱积雪/无雪
# 2 = 过渡区
# 3 = 稳定积雪区
# =========================
ndsi_rules = [
    (-100.0, 10.0, 1.0),
    (10.0, 40.0, 2.0),
    (40.0, 100.0, 3.0)
]
ndsi_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(ndsi_clip, ndsi_rules)

# =========================
# 7. 各地形因子解释力评估
# 因变量正常值范围控制为 -100 ~ 100
# =========================
snow_min = -100.0
snow_max = 100.0

geo_res_dem = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    "elevation",
    dem_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    "slope",
    slope_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_aspect = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    "aspect",
    aspect_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_position = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    "position",
    position_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

# =========================
# 8. 积雪敏感地形带（示意性提取）
# 这里用一个较简单的组合：
# 高高程 + 北向坡 + 中低坡度
# 用于给出“敏感地形带”参考结果
# =========================
elev_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(
    dem_class,
    [(-0.5, 3.5, 0.0), (3.5, 5.5, 1.0)]
)

aspect_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(
    aspect_class,
    [(0.5, 1.5, 1.0), (1.5, 4.5, 0.0)]
)

slope_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(
    slope_class,
    [(-0.5, 0.5, 0.0), (0.5, 3.5, 1.0), (3.5, 5.5, 0.0)]
)

tmp_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(elev_sensitive, aspect_sensitive)

snow_sensitive_score = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_sensitive, slope_sensitive)

snow_sensitive_band = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(
    snow_sensitive_score,
    [(-0.5, 2.5, 0.0), (2.5, 3.5, 1.0)]
)

# =========================
# 9. 可视化与输出
# =========================
ndsi_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#f0f0f0",  # 弱积雪/无雪
        "#9ecae1",  # 过渡区
        "#2171b5"   # 稳定积雪区
    ]
}

sensitive_vis = {
    "min": 0,
    "max": 1,
    "palette": [
        "#d9d9d9",
        "#d73027"
    ]
}

ndsi_class.styles(ndsi_vis).getMap("积雪分布结果")
snow_sensitive_band.styles(sensitive_vis).getMap("积雪敏感地形带结果")

geo_res_dem.log("高程因子积雪解释结果")
geo_res_slope.log("坡度因子积雪解释结果")
geo_res_aspect.log("坡向因子积雪解释结果")
geo_res_position.log("相对地形位置因子积雪解释结果")

    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(green, 0.0000275)

green = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(green, -0.2)

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(swir1, 0.0000275)

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(swir1, -0.2)

ndsi_num = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(green, swir1)

ndsi_den = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(green, swir1)

ndsi = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.divide"
).execute(ndsi_num, ndsi_den)

# 缩放到 -100 ~ 100，便于后续分层和 geoDetector
ndsi_scaled = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(ndsi, 100.0)

# =========================
# 3. 对齐 DEM 与 NDSI 的重叠区域
# =========================
ndsi_clip = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reproject"
).execute(ndsi_scaled, 3857, 30)

dem_clip = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reproject"
).execute(dem, 3857, 30)

# =========================
# 4. 派生地形因子
# - 高程
# - 坡度
# - 坡向
# - 相对地形位置
# =========================
# EPSG:3857为米制坐标，z-factor使用1.0
slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_clip, 1, 1.0)

aspect = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrAspect"
).execute(dem_clip, 1)

dem_local_mean = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(dem_clip, "circle", 9)

relative_position = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(dem_clip, dem_local_mean)

relative_position_smooth = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.focalMean"
).execute(relative_position, "circle", 1)

# =========================
# 5. 各地形因子离散化
# =========================

# 高程分层
dem_rules = [
    (0.0, 300.0, 1.0),
    (300.0, 500.0, 2.0),
    (500.0, 700.0, 3.0),
    (700.0, 900.0, 4.0),
    (900.0, 5000.0, 5.0)
]
dem_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(dem_clip, dem_rules)

# 坡度分层
slope_rules = [
    (0.0, 5.0, 1.0),
    (5.0, 15.0, 2.0),
    (15.0, 25.0, 3.0),
    (25.0, 35.0, 4.0),
    (35.0, 90.0, 5.0)
]
slope_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# 坡向分组（北 / 东 / 南 / 西）
aspect_rules = [
    (0.0, 45.0, 1.0),
    (45.0, 135.0, 2.0),
    (135.0, 225.0, 3.0),
    (225.0, 315.0, 4.0),
    (315.0, 361.0, 1.0)
]
aspect_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(aspect, aspect_rules)

# 相对地形位置分层
position_rules = [
    (-5000.0, -20.0, 1.0),
    (-20.0, -5.0, 2.0),
    (-5.0, 5.0, 3.0),
    (5.0, 20.0, 4.0),
    (20.0, 5000.0, 5.0)
]
position_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(relative_position_smooth, position_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 积雪结果分层
# 这里用 NDSI 表达：
# 1 = 弱积雪/无雪
# 2 = 过渡区
# 3 = 稳定积雪区
# =========================
ndsi_rules = [
    (-100.0, 10.0, 1.0),
    (10.0, 40.0, 2.0),
    (40.0, 100.0, 3.0)
]
ndsi_class = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(ndsi_clip, ndsi_rules)

# =========================
# 7. 各地形因子解释力评估
# 因变量正常值范围控制为 -100 ~ 100
# =========================
snow_min = -100.0
snow_max = 100.0

geo_res_dem = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    "elevation",
    dem_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    "slope",
    slope_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_aspect = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    "aspect",
    aspect_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_position = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.geoDetector"
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    "position",
    position_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

# =========================
# 8. 积雪敏感地形带（示意性提取）
# 这里用一个较简单的组合：
# 高高程 + 北向坡 + 中低坡度
# 用于给出“敏感地形带”参考结果
# =========================
elev_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(
    dem_class,
    [(-0.5, 3.5, 0.0), (3.5, 5.5, 1.0)]
)

aspect_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(
    aspect_class,
    [(0.5, 1.5, 1.0), (1.5, 4.5, 0.0)]
)

slope_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(
    slope_class,
    [(-0.5, 0.5, 0.0), (0.5, 3.5, 1.0), (3.5, 5.5, 0.0)]
)

tmp_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(elev_sensitive, aspect_sensitive)

snow_sensitive_score = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(tmp_sensitive, slope_sensitive)

snow_sensitive_band = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reclass"
).execute(
    snow_sensitive_score,
    [(-0.5, 2.5, 0.0), (2.5, 3.5, 1.0)]
)

# =========================
# 9. 可视化与输出
# =========================
ndsi_vis = {
    "min": 1,
    "max": 3,
    "palette": [
        "#f0f0f0",  # 弱积雪/无雪
        "#9ecae1",  # 过渡区
        "#2171b5"   # 稳定积雪区
    ]
}

sensitive_vis = {
    "min": 0,
    "max": 1,
    "palette": [
        "#d9d9d9",
        "#d73027"
    ]
}

ndsi_class.styles(ndsi_vis).getMap("积雪分布结果")
snow_sensitive_band.styles(sensitive_vis).getMap("积雪敏感地形带结果")

geo_res_dem.log("高程因子积雪解释结果")
geo_res_slope.log("坡度因子积雪解释结果")
geo_res_aspect.log("坡向因子积雪解释结果")
geo_res_position.log("相对地形位置因子积雪解释结果")

import oge

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service.initialize()

# =========================
# 1. 读取武汉市交通设施
# =========================
trans_2023 = service.getFeatureCollection(
    productId="wuhan_trans_stations_2023",
    crs="EPSG:4326"
)

# =========================
# 2. 构造走廊线
# =========================
corridor_geom = service.getProcess(
    "Geometry.LineString"
).execute(
    [
        [114.10, 30.45],
        [114.30, 30.58],
        [114.55, 30.72]
    ],
    "EPSG:4326"
)

corridor_feature = service.getProcess(
    "Feature.loadFromGeometry"
).execute(
    corridor_geom,
    {"name": "main_corridor"}
)

# =========================
# 3. 建立1000米缓冲区
# =========================
corridor_buffer = service.getProcess(
    "Feature.buffer"
).execute(
    corridor_feature,
    1000,
    "EPSG:4326"
)

# 将缓冲区Feature转换为FeatureCollection
corridor_fc = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList"
).execute(
    [corridor_buffer]
)

# 提取真正的缓冲区Geometry
corridor_buffer_geom = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.geometryGetAndMerge"
).execute(
    corridor_fc,
    "geom"
)

# =========================
# 4. 筛选公交站
# =========================
bus_stop = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.filterMetadata"
).execute(
    trans_2023,
    "fclass",
    "equals",
    "bus_stop"
)

# =========================
# 5. 筛选缓冲区内的公交站
# 使用filterBounds，不生成空的相交几何
# =========================
bus_in_corridor = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.filterBounds"
).execute(
    bus_stop,
    corridor_buffer_geom,
    "geom"
)

# =========================
# 6. 输出数量，辅助检查
# =========================
bus_total_count = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.size"
).execute(bus_stop)

bus_corridor_count = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.size"
).execute(bus_in_corridor)

bus_total_count.log("公交站总数")
bus_corridor_count.log("走廊内公交站数量")

# =========================
# 7. 地图展示
# =========================
corridor_fc.styles(
    ["#FFF3A3"]
).getMap("01_走廊1000米缓冲区")

corridor_feature.styles(
    ["#0066FF"]
).getMap("02_走廊中心线")

bus_stop.styles(
    ["#808080"]
).getMap("03_全部公交站")

bus_in_corridor.styles(
    ["#FF0000"]
).getMap("04_走廊内公交站点")

oge.mapclient.centerMap(
    114.30,
    30.60,
    10
)

)

ferry_b_only = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.filterBounds"
).execute(
    ferry_terminal,
    corridor_b_only_geom,
    "geom"
)

# =========================

bus_shared_count = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.size"

bus_a_only_count = service.getProcess(

ferry_a_only_count.log("ferry_terminal_corridor_a_only_count")
ferry_b_only_count.log("ferry_terminal_corridor_b_only_count")

    productId="wuhan_road_network_2023",
    crs="EPSG:4326"
)
trans_2023 = service.getFeatureCollection(
    productId="wuhan_trans_stations_2023",
    crs="EPSG:4326"
)

# 2) 构造两个部分重叠的分析区
zone_a_geom = service.getProcess("Geometry.Polygon").execute(
    [[[114.08, 30.48], [114.08, 30.72], [114.36, 30.72],
      [114.36, 30.48], [114.08, 30.48]]],
    "EPSG:4326"
)
zone_b_geom = service.getProcess("Geometry.Polygon").execute(
    [[[114.24, 30.44], [114.24, 30.68], [114.56, 30.68],
      [114.56, 30.44], [114.24, 30.44]]],
    "EPSG:4326"
)

zone_a_feature = service.getProcess("Feature.loadFromGeometry").execute(
    zone_a_geom,
    {"name": "zone_a"}
)
zone_b_feature = service.getProcess("Feature.loadFromGeometry").execute(
    zone_b_geom,
    {"name": "zone_b"}
)

zone_a_fc = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList").execute(
    [zone_a_feature]
)
zone_b_fc = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList").execute(
    [zone_b_feature]
)

# 3) 提取共享区、A独有区和B独有区
shared_zone = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.intersection").execute(
    zone_a_fc,
    zone_b_fc
)
zone_a_only = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.difference").execute(
    zone_a_fc,
    zone_b_fc,
    "geom",
    "geom"
)
zone_b_only = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.difference").execute(
    zone_b_fc,
    zone_a_fc,
    "geom",
    "geom"
)

# 提取三个分区的Geometry，用于设施空间筛选
shared_geom = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.geometryGetAndMerge"
).execute(shared_zone, "geom")

zone_a_only_geom = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.geometryGetAndMerge"
).execute(zone_a_only, "geom")

zone_b_only_geom = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.geometryGetAndMerge"
).execute(zone_b_only, "geom")

)

    "equals",
    "primary"
)

).execute(

    "fclass",
    "equals",

)

    "FeatureCollection.filterBounds"
).execute(
    ferry_terminal,
    shared_geom,
    "geom"
)

    "FeatureCollection.filterBounds"
).execute(
    ferry_terminal,
    zone_a_only_geom,
    "geom"
)
ferry_b_only = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.filterBounds"
).execute(
    ferry_terminal,
    zone_b_only_geom,
    "geom"
)

).log("zone_b_only_count")

service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.size").execute(
    road_skeleton
).log("road_skeleton_total_count")

service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.size").execute(
    ferry_terminal
).log("ferry_terminal_total_count")

service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.size").execute(
    ferry_shared
).log("ferry_shared_count")

service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.size").execute(
    ferry_a_only
).log("ferry_a_only_count")

service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.size").execute(
    ferry_b_only
).log("ferry_b_only_count")

# 8) 地图展示
zone_a_only.styles(["#66CCFF"]).getMap("A独有区")
zone_b_only.styles(["#CCCCCC"]).getMap("B独有区")
shared_zone.styles(["#FFCC00"]).getMap("重叠共享区")

road_skeleton.styles(["#0055FF"]).getMap("高等级道路骨架")

ferry_b_only.styles(["#AA00FF"]).getMap("B独有区渡口")
ferry_shared.styles(["#FF0000"]).getMap("共享区渡口")

    "EPSG:4326"

    corridor_geom, {"name": "candidate_corridor"}
)

    corridor_feature, 800, "EPSG:4326"
)

).execute([candidate_buffer])

b2 = service.getProcess("Coverage.selectBands").execute(lc08_float, ["B2"])

denominator_siwsi = service.getProcess("Coverage.add").execute(b6, b2)
siwsi = service.getProcess("Coverage.divide").execute(numerator_siwsi, denominator_siwsi)

import oge

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()


# 修改产品ID，场景ID保持不变
landsat8 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC08_L1TP_144030_20230831_20230906_02_T1",
    productID="LC08_C02_L1"
)
landsat8_double = service.getProcess("Coverage.toDouble").execute(landsat8)
DEM = service.getCoverage(coverageID="ASTGTM_N43E084", productID="ASTER_GDEM_DEM30")

ndvi = service.getProcess("Coverage.normalizedDifference").execute(landsat8_double, ["B5", "B4"])
ndvi_mul = service.getProcess( "Coverage.multiplyNum").execute(ndvi, 100.0)

# rasterUnion已删除：统一NDVI与DEM的投影和分辨率
ndvi_mul_clip = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reproject"
).execute(ndvi_mul, 3857, 30)

dem_clip = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.reproject"
).execute(DEM, 3857, 30)

# EPSG:3857的水平单位为米，z-factor使用1.0
slope = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrSlope"
).execute(dem_clip, 1, 1.0)

# aspect改为当前可用的terrAspect
aspect = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.terrAspect"
).execute(dem_clip, 1)

NaN_value = -0

dem_reclass = service.getProcess( "Coverage.reclass").execute(dem_clip,
            [(500, 1500, 1), (1500, 2500, 2),(2500, 3000, 3), (3000, 3500, 4), (3500, 4500, 5)])

slope_reclass = service.getProcess( "Coverage.reclass").execute(slope,
            [(0, 5, 1), (5, 15, 2),(15, 25, 3), (25, 35, 4), (35, 45, 5), (45, 90, 6)])

aspect_reclass = service.getProcess( "Coverage.reclass").execute(aspect,
    [(0, 60, 1), (60, 120, 2), (120, 180, 3),(180, 240, 4), (240, 300, 5), (300, 360, 6)])

ndvi_reclass = service.getProcess( "Coverage.reclass").execute(ndvi_mul_clip,
                [(-50, 0, 1), (0, 10, 2),(10, 20, 3),(20, 30, 4), (30, 40, 5), (40, 50, 6)])

vis_params = {}
ndvi_reclass.styles(vis_params).getMap("重分类NDVI数据")

ndvi_norExtent = [-100,100]
geo_res_dem = service.getProcess( "Coverage.geoDetector").execute(ndvi_mul_clip,
    "dem",dem_reclass,ndvi_norExtent[0],ndvi_norExtent[1],NaN_value
)
geo_res_slope = service.getProcess( "Coverage.geoDetector").execute(ndvi_mul_clip,
    "slope",slope_reclass,ndvi_norExtent[0],ndvi_norExtent[1],NaN_value
)
geo_res_aspect = service.getProcess( "Coverage.geoDetector").execute(ndvi_mul_clip,
    "aspect",aspect_reclass,ndvi_norExtent[0],ndvi_norExtent[1],NaN_value
)
geo_res_ndvi = service.getProcess( "Coverage.geoDetector").execute(ndvi_mul_clip,
    "ndvi",ndvi_reclass,ndvi_norExtent[0],ndvi_norExtent[1],NaN_value
)

geo_res_dem.log("高程因子计算结果")
geo_res_slope.log("坡度因子计算结果")
geo_res_aspect.log("坡向因子计算结果")
geo_res_ndvi.log("NDVI因子（对照组）计算结果")

oge.mapclient.centerMap(115,31,4)

vis_params = {"palette": ["#ffffcc", "#ffeda0", "#fed976", "#feb24c", "#fd8d3c", "#fc4e2a", "#e31a1c", "#bd0026", "#800026"]}

morani = service.getProcess("SpatialStats.STCorrelations.SpatialAutoCorrelation.globalMoranI").execute(
    feature, "aging", "false", "true", "W"
)

re_lisa = service.getProcess("SpatialStats.STCorrelations.SpatialAutoCorrelation.localMoranI").execute(
    feature, "aging", "false"
)

re_gwss = service.getProcess("SpatialStats.GWModels.GWAverage").execute(
    feature, "aging", "pcgdp,gi,fd,education", 50, "bisquare", "true", "false"
)

rast_lisa = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.rasterize").execute(
    re_lisa, "local_moranI"
)
rast_lisa.styles(vis_params).getMap("LISA结果")

rast_gwss = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.rasterize").execute(
    re_gwss, "PCGDP_LM"
)
rast_gwss.styles(vis_params).getMap("人均GDP变量局部地理加权平均值")

re_corr = service.getProcess("SpatialStats.STCorrelations.CorrelationAnalysis.corrMat").execute(
    feature, "aging,pcgdp,gi,fd,ts,cl,pcd,pip,sip,tip,education", "pearson"
)

re_detect = service.getProcess("SpatialStats.SpatialHeterogeneity.GeoFactorDetector").execute(
    feature, "aging", "pcgdp,gi,fd,ts,cl,pcd,pip,sip,tip,education"
)

re_corr.log("相关系数矩阵\n")
morani.log("全局莫兰指数\n")
re_detect.log("地理探测器因子探测器结果\n")

    feature, "aging", "pcgdp,gi,fd,education", "true"
)

    feature, "aging", "pcgdp,gi,fd,education"
)

re_gwr = service.getProcess("SpatialStats.GWModels.GWRbasic.autoFit").execute(
    feature, "aging", "pcgdp,gi,fd,education", "bisquare", "AICc", "true"
)

# 读取包含B10和B11的Landsat 9 Level-1在线数据

    coverageID="LC09_L1TP_122039_20211112_20230506_02_T1",
    productID="LC09_C02_L1"
)

# 提取两个热红外波段
tir10 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(
    lc09,
    ["B10"]
)

tir11 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(
    lc09,
    ["B11"]
)

# 转为浮点型，保证除法保留小数
tir10 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.toFloat"
).execute(tir10)

tir11 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.toFloat"
).execute(tir11)

# OGE二元栅格运算要求波段结构一致
tir10 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.rename"
).execute(
    tir10,
    ["thermal"]
)

tir11 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.rename"
).execute(
    tir11,
    ["thermal"]
)

# NDTI = (B10 - B11) / (B10 + B11)
numerator = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(
    tir10,
    tir11
)

denominator = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(
    tir10,
    tir11
)

ndti = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.divide"
).execute(

)

import oge

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# ============================================================
# 1. 读取Landsat Collection 2 Level-2数据
# ============================================================
landsat_l2 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LC09_L2SP_125023_20211031_20230507_02_T1",
    productID="LC09_C02_L2"
)

landsat_l2 = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.toFloat"
).execute(landsat_l2)

# ============================================================
# 2. 提取红光、近红外和地表温度波段
# 使用波段号：SR_B4、SR_B5、ST_B10
# ============================================================
red_dn = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(landsat_l2, ["SR_B4"])

nir_dn = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(landsat_l2, ["SR_B5"])

st_dn = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.selectBands"
).execute(landsat_l2, ["ST_B10"])

# ============================================================
# 3. Collection 2 Level-2地表反射率定标
#
# Reflectance = DN × 0.0000275 - 0.2
# ============================================================
red = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(red_dn, 0.0000275)

red = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(red, -0.2)

nir = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(nir_dn, 0.0000275)

nir = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(nir, -0.2)

# ============================================================
# 4. 使用定标后的反射率计算NDVI
#
# NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)
#
# 由于反射率存在-0.2偏移，不能直接在原始DN上调用
# normalizedDifference，因此手动计算。
# ============================================================
ndvi_num = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(nir, red)

ndvi_den = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.add"
).execute(nir, red)

ndvi = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.divide"
).execute(ndvi_num, ndvi_den)

# ============================================================
# 5. Collection 2 Level-2地表温度定标
#
# LST(K) = DN × 0.00341802 + 149
# LST(℃) = LST(K) - 273.15
# ============================================================
lst_k = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(st_dn, 0.00341802)

lst_k = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(lst_k, 149.0)

lst_c = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtractNum"
).execute(lst_k, 273.15)

# ============================================================
# 6. 构造NDVI-LST湿边和干边
#
# 湿边：Twet = 25 - 10 × NDVI
# 干边：Tdry = 45 - 5 × NDVI
#
# 这些参数适合作为代码Demo参数。
# 定量研究时应从当前场景的NDVI-LST散点空间拟合。
# ============================================================
wet_edge = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(ndvi, -10.0)

wet_edge = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(wet_edge, 25.0)

dry_edge = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.multiplyNum"
).execute(ndvi, -5.0)

dry_edge = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.addNum"
).execute(dry_edge, 45.0)

# ============================================================
# 7. 计算TVDI
#
# TVDI = (LST - Twet) / (Tdry - Twet)
# ============================================================
tvdi_num = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(lst_c, wet_edge)

tvdi_den = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.subtract"
).execute(dry_edge, wet_edge)

tvdi = service.getProcess(
    "Coverage.divide"
).execute(tvdi_num, tvdi_den)

# ============================================================
# 8. 地图展示
# ============================================================
tvdi_vis = {
    "min": 0,
    "max": 1,
    "palette": [
        "#0000ff",
        "#00ffff",
        "#00ff00",
        "#ffff00",
        "#ffa500",
        "#ff0000",
        "#800000"
    ]
}

tvdi.styles(tvdi_vis).getMap("温度植被干旱指数 TVDI")


# 影像中心点位可视化
oge.mapclient.centerMap(118.86948458090001,53.085515813,11)

import oge
from oge import Filter

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service.initialize()

coverage = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LJ3II_MSS_E114.07_N30.36_20241221_L1A_010_GS",
    productID="LJ3II_PAN_MSS"
)

# 分支1：水体提取
water = service.getProcess("whu01_water").execute(coverage)

# 分支2：船舶检测
ships = service.getProcess("whu-ship").execute(coverage)

# 构造船舶几何与水体几何的相交过滤条件
filter_intersect = Filter.intersects(
    leftGeometryFieldName="geom",
    rightGeometryFieldName="geom",
    maxError=0.0
)

# 保留与水体相交的船舶
ships_filtered = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.intersectionByFilter"
).execute(
    leftCollection=ships,
    rightCollection=water,
    leftGeomField="geom",
    rightGeomField="geom",
    joinType="inner",
    joinFilter=filter_intersect
)

ships_filtered.export("ships_filtered")

oge.mapclient.centerMap(114.07, 30.36, 11)
