import oge
from oge import Filter

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service.initialize()

# 读取武汉一号遥感影像
coverage = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LJ3II_MSS_E114.07_N30.36_20241221_L1A_010_GS",
    productID="LJ3II_PAN_MSS"
)

# 分支1：提取主干道
roads = service.getProcess(
    "whu-mainroad"
).execute(coverage)

# 当前结果采用EPSG:4326坐标系
# 以0.0003度近似构建30米道路邻近范围
road_buffer = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.buffer"
).execute(
    roads,
    0.0003,
    "geom"
)

# 分支2：提取耕地图斑
cultivated_land = service.getProcess(
    "whu-cultivated_land"
).execute(coverage)

# 构建耕地图斑与道路邻近范围的相交过滤条件
filter_intersect = Filter.intersects(
    leftGeometryFieldName="geom",
    rightGeometryFieldName="geom",
    maxError=0.0
)

# 筛选与道路邻近范围相交的完整耕地图斑
roadside_cultivated_land = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.intersectionByFilter"
).execute(
    leftCollection=cultivated_land,
    rightCollection=road_buffer,
    leftGeomField="geom",
    rightGeomField="geom",
    joinType="inner",
    joinFilter=filter_intersect
)

# 导出最终结果
roadside_cultivated_land.export(
    "roadside_cultivated_land"
)

# 设置前端地图中心位置和显示层级
oge.mapclient.centerMap(
    114.07,
    30.36,
    11
)

)

import oge
from oge import Filter

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service.initialize()

# 构建船舶与水体之间的空间相交条件
filter_intersect = Filter.intersects(
    leftGeometryFieldName="geom",
    rightGeometryFieldName="geom",
    maxError=0.0
)

# ==================================================
# 时期一：2024年9月16日
# ==================================================
coverage_t1 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LJ3II_MSS_E114.30_N30.53_20240916_L1A_020_GS",
    productID="LJ3II_PAN_MSS"
)

# 提取水体
water_t1 = service.getProcess(
    "whu01_water"
).execute(coverage_t1)

# 检测船舶
ships_t1 = service.getProcess(
    "whu-ship"
).execute(coverage_t1)

# 筛选与水体范围相交的船舶目标
ships_on_water_t1 = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.intersectionByFilter"
).execute(
    leftCollection=ships_t1,
    rightCollection=water_t1,
    leftGeomField="geom",
    rightGeomField="geom",
    joinType="inner",
    joinFilter=filter_intersect
)

# 为每个船舶目标设置计数属性
ships_result_t1 = service.getProcess(
    "FeatureCollection.constantColumn"
).execute(
    ships_on_water_t1,

)

import oge

# 初始化
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service.initialize()

# ==================================================
# 1. 读取武汉一号高分辨率影像
# ==================================================
coverage = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID="LJ3II_MSS_E114.07_N30.36_20241221_L1A_010_GS",
    productID="LJ3II_PAN_MSS"
)

# ==================================================
# 2. 三个模型独立执行地物提取
# ==================================================
# 分支一：主干道提取
roads = service.getProcess("whu-mainroad").execute(coverage)

# 分支二：水体提取
water = service.getProcess("whu01_water").execute(coverage)

# 分支三：耕地提取
cultivated_land = service.getProcess("whu-cultivated_land").execute(coverage)

# ==================================================
# 3. 为不同地物结果增加统一类别属性
# ==================================================
# 主干道类别
roads_labeled = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.constantColumn").execute(
    roads,
    "land_type",
    "main_road"
)

# 水体类别
water_labeled = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.constantColumn").execute(
    water,
    "land_type",
    "water"
)

# 耕地类别
cultivated_land_labeled = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.constantColumn").execute(
    cultivated_land,
    "land_type",
    "cultivated_land"
)

# ==================================================
# 4. 合并三类地物矢量结果
# ==================================================
# 先合并主干道和水体
road_water = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.merge").execute(
    roads_labeled,
    water_labeled
)

# 再加入耕地结果
urban_interpretation = service.getProcess("FeatureCollection.merge").execute(
    road_water,
    cultivated_land_labeled
)

# ==================================================
# 5. 批处理导出综合解译结果
# ==================================================
urban_interpretation.export("urban_comprehensive_interpretation")

# 设置前端地图中心位置和显示层级
oge.mapclient.centerMap(114.07, 30.36, 11)

"T0042","terrain_analysis","zh","基于宜昌附近单景 DEM 数据，在小、中、大三种尺度下分别计算地形粗糙度，并综合不同尺度下的粗糙度等级和高粗糙出现情况，形成低复杂度、中复杂度和高复杂度的综合等级结果，用于表达研究区地形复杂程度在尺度变化下的整体差异。","import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取单景 ALOS DEM
# =========================
dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID=""n030e111"",
    productID=""ALOS_PALSAR_DEM12.5""
)



# =========================
# 2. 构建小/中/大尺度 DEM
# 思路：先对 DEM 做不同尺度平滑，再分别计算 TRI
# 这样 TRI 本身仍是局部崎岖度，但其作用尺度不同
# =========================
# 小尺度：基本保持原始地形细节
dem_small = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.focalMean""
).execute(dem, ""circle"", 1)

# 中尺度：适度平滑
dem_medium = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.focalMean""
).execute(dem, ""circle"", 3)

# 大尺度：更强平滑
dem_large = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.focalMean""
).execute(dem, ""circle"", 7)

# =========================
# 3. 分别计算小/中/大尺度粗糙度（TRI）
# =========================
tri_small = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL""
).execute(dem_small, 1, ""False"", """")

tri_medium = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL""
).execute(dem_medium, 1, ""False"", """")

tri_large = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.triTerrainRuggednessIndexByGDAL""
).execute(dem_large, 1, ""False"", """")

# =========================
# 4. 对三组粗糙度结果分别分级
# 1 = 低粗糙
# 2 = 中粗糙
# 3 = 高粗糙
#
# 大尺度 DEM 已经过平滑，因此 TRI 阈值随尺度变大而降低
# =========================
small_rules = [
    (0.0, 8.0, 1.0),
    (8.0, 20.0, 2.0),
    (20.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

medium_rules = [
    (0.0, 5.0, 1.0),
    (5.0, 12.0, 2.0),
    (12.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

large_rules = [
    (0.0, 3.0, 1.0),
    (3.0, 8.0, 2.0),
    (8.0, 5000.0, 3.0)
]

tri_small_class = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(tri_small, small_rules)

tri_medium_class = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(tri_medium, medium_rules)

tri_large_class = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(tri_large, large_rules)

# =========================
# 5. 各尺度高粗糙候选区提取
# 0 = 非高粗糙
# 1 = 高粗糙
# =========================
high_rules = [
    (-0.5, 2.5, 0.0),
    (2.5, 3.5, 1.0)
]

small_high = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(tri_small_class, high_rules)

medium_high = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(tri_medium_class, high_rules)

large_high = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(tri_large_class, high_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 统计高粗糙出现次数
# high_count = 0,1,2,3
# 同时计算三尺度等级总和（3~9）
# =========================
tmp_high = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.add""
).execute(small_high, medium_high)

high_count = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.add""
).execute(tmp_high, large_high)

tmp_sum = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.add""
).execute(tri_small_class, tri_medium_class)

roughness_sum = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.add""
).execute(tmp_sum, tri_large_class)

# =========================
# 7. 构建综合复杂度分数
# combined_score = high_count * 10 + roughness_sum
#
# 设计思想：
# - 多尺度高粗糙出现次数越多，复杂度越高
# - 即便没有达到“高粗糙”，如果三个尺度总和偏高，也可进入中复杂度
# =========================
high_count_x10 = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.multiplyNum""
).execute(high_count, 10)

combined_score = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.add""
).execute(high_count_x10, roughness_sum)

# =========================
# 8. 归并为综合复杂度等级
# 1 = 低复杂度
# 2 = 中复杂度
# 3 = 高复杂度
#
# 规则解释：
# - high_count = 0，且总和较低 -> 低复杂度
# - high_count = 0，但总和偏高；或 high_count = 1 -> 中复杂度
# - high_count >= 2 -> 高复杂度
# =========================
complexity_rules = [
    (-0.5, 4.5, 1.0),    # 3,4 -> 低复杂度
    (4.5, 6.5, 2.0),     # 5,6 -> 中复杂度
    (14.5, 19.5, 2.0),   # 15~19 -> 单尺度高粗糙，判为中复杂度
    (24.5, 39.5, 3.0)    # 25~39 -> 多尺度高粗糙，判为高复杂度
]

complexity = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(combined_score, complexity_rules)

# =========================
# 9. 轻量去碎斑
# =========================
complexity_smooth = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.focalMode""
).execute(complexity, ""circle"", 1)

# =========================
# 10. 可视化
# =========================
roughness_vis = {
    ""min"": 1,
    ""max"": 3,
    ""palette"": [
        ""#edf8fb"",  # 低粗糙
        ""#9ecae1"",  # 中粗糙
        ""#08519c""   # 高粗糙
    ]
}

complexity_vis = {
    ""min"": 1,
    ""max"": 3,
    ""palette"": [
        ""#d9d9d9"",  # 低复杂度
        ""#fdae61"",  # 中复杂度
        ""#d73027""   # 高复杂度
    ]
}

tri_small_class.styles(roughness_vis).getMap(""小尺度粗糙度结果"")
tri_medium_class.styles(roughness_vis).getMap(""中尺度粗糙度结果"")
tri_large_class.styles(roughness_vis).getMap(""大尺度粗糙度结果"")

"T0043","terrain_analysis","zh","基于宜昌附近单景 DEM 数据，分别从细尺度表面破碎度和中大尺度区域起伏两个角度识别地形特征，区分局部破碎但不形成明显区域起伏的地形、区域尺度上具有明显起伏结构但局部表面不一定特别破碎的地形，以及同时具备两类特征的复合区，形成局部破碎区、区域性起伏区、复合区和一般区的专题结果。","import oge

# =========================
# 初始化

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取单景 ALOS DEM

dem = service.getCoverage(

# =========================
dem_base = service.getProcess(

# =========================
# 3. 细尺度粗糙度（局部破碎度）

# =========================
dem_small = service.getProcess(

).execute(dem_base, ""circle"", 1)

tri_small = service.getProcess(

).execute(dem_small, 1, ""False"", """")

focal_min = service.getProcess(

).execute(dem_base, ""circle"", 11)

regional_relief = service.getProcess(

).execute(focal_max, focal_min)

# =========================

# 3 = 高破碎
#
# 中大尺度起伏：

# =========================
# 6. 提取高破碎候选区与高起伏候选区
# 0 = 否
# 1 = 是

broken_high = service.getProcess(

"T0051","terrain_analysis","zh","基于 Landsat 冬季影像构建积雪覆盖指标，并结合 DEM 派生的高程、坡度、坡向和相对地形位置等因子，对研究区积雪空间分布差异进行解释分析，比较不同地形因子对积雪格局的解释作用强弱，识别更可能影响积雪分布的主导地形因子，并提取积雪敏感地形带。","import oge

# =========================
# 初始化
# =========================
oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# =========================
# 1. 读取冬季光学影像与 DEM
# =========================
landsat = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID=""LC09_L2SP_115028_20230116_20230313_02_T1"",
    productID=""LC09_C02_L2""
)

dem = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID=""ASTGTM_N45E130"",
    productID=""ASTER_GDEM_DEM30""
)

NaN_value = 0

# =========================
# 2. 提取 Green / SWIR1 波段并计算 NDSI
# Landsat 9 L2:
# Green = SR_B3
# SWIR1 = SR_B6
#
# 按 Collection 2 Level-2 SR 的常用缩放：
# reflectance = DN * 0.0000275 - 0.2
# =========================
green = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.selectBands""
).execute(landsat, [""SR_B3""])

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.selectBands""
).execute(landsat, [""SR_B6""])

green = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.toDouble""
).execute(green)

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.toDouble""
).execute(swir1)

green = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.multiplyNum""
).execute(green, 0.0000275)

green = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.addNum""
).execute(green, -0.2)

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.multiplyNum""
).execute(swir1, 0.0000275)

swir1 = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.addNum""
).execute(swir1, -0.2)

ndsi_num = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.subtract""
).execute(green, swir1)

ndsi_den = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.add""
).execute(green, swir1)

ndsi = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.divide""
).execute(ndsi_num, ndsi_den)

# 缩放到 -100 ~ 100，便于后续分层和 geoDetector
ndsi_scaled = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.multiplyNum""
).execute(ndsi, 100.0)

# =========================
# 3. 对齐 DEM 与 NDSI 的重叠区域
# =========================
ndsi_clip = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reproject""
).execute(ndsi_scaled, 3857, 30)

dem_clip = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reproject""
).execute(dem, 3857, 30)

# =========================
# 4. 派生地形因子
# - 高程
# - 坡度
# - 坡向
# - 相对地形位置
# =========================
# EPSG:3857为米制坐标，z-factor使用1.0
slope = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.terrSlope""
).execute(dem_clip, 1, 1.0)

aspect = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.terrAspect""
).execute(dem_clip, 1)

dem_local_mean = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.focalMean""
).execute(dem_clip, ""circle"", 9)

relative_position = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.subtract""
).execute(dem_clip, dem_local_mean)

relative_position_smooth = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.focalMean""
).execute(relative_position, ""circle"", 1)

# =========================
# 5. 各地形因子离散化
# =========================

# 高程分层
dem_rules = [
    (0.0, 300.0, 1.0),
    (300.0, 500.0, 2.0),
    (500.0, 700.0, 3.0),
    (700.0, 900.0, 4.0),
    (900.0, 5000.0, 5.0)
]
dem_class = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(dem_clip, dem_rules)

# 坡度分层
slope_rules = [
    (0.0, 5.0, 1.0),
    (5.0, 15.0, 2.0),
    (15.0, 25.0, 3.0),
    (25.0, 35.0, 4.0),
    (35.0, 90.0, 5.0)
]
slope_class = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(slope, slope_rules)

# 坡向分组（北 / 东 / 南 / 西）
aspect_rules = [
    (0.0, 45.0, 1.0),
    (45.0, 135.0, 2.0),
    (135.0, 225.0, 3.0),
    (225.0, 315.0, 4.0),
    (315.0, 361.0, 1.0)
]
aspect_class = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(aspect, aspect_rules)

# 相对地形位置分层
position_rules = [
    (-5000.0, -20.0, 1.0),
    (-20.0, -5.0, 2.0),
    (-5.0, 5.0, 3.0),
    (5.0, 20.0, 4.0),
    (20.0, 5000.0, 5.0)
]
position_class = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(relative_position_smooth, position_rules)

# =========================
# 6. 积雪结果分层
# 这里用 NDSI 表达：
# 1 = 弱积雪/无雪
# 2 = 过渡区
# 3 = 稳定积雪区
# =========================
ndsi_rules = [
    (-100.0, 10.0, 1.0),
    (10.0, 40.0, 2.0),
    (40.0, 100.0, 3.0)
]
ndsi_class = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(ndsi_clip, ndsi_rules)

# =========================
# 7. 各地形因子解释力评估
# 因变量正常值范围控制为 -100 ~ 100
# =========================
snow_min = -100.0
snow_max = 100.0

geo_res_dem = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.geoDetector""
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    ""elevation"",
    dem_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_slope = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.geoDetector""
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    ""slope"",
    slope_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_aspect = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.geoDetector""
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    ""aspect"",
    aspect_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

geo_res_position = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.geoDetector""
).execute(
    ndsi_clip,
    ""position"",
    position_class,
    snow_min,
    snow_max,
    NaN_value
)

# =========================
# 8. 积雪敏感地形带（示意性提取）
# 这里用一个较简单的组合：
# 高高程 + 北向坡 + 中低坡度
# 用于给出“敏感地形带”参考结果
# =========================
elev_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(
    dem_class,
    [(-0.5, 3.5, 0.0), (3.5, 5.5, 1.0)]
)

aspect_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(
    aspect_class,
    [(0.5, 1.5, 1.0), (1.5, 4.5, 0.0)]
)

slope_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(
    slope_class,
    [(-0.5, 0.5, 0.0), (0.5, 3.5, 1.0), (3.5, 5.5, 0.0)]
)

tmp_sensitive = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.add""
).execute(elev_sensitive, aspect_sensitive)

snow_sensitive_score = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.add""
).execute(tmp_sensitive, slope_sensitive)

snow_sensitive_band = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.reclass""
).execute(
    snow_sensitive_score,
    [(-0.5, 2.5, 0.0), (2.5, 3.5, 1.0)]
)

# =========================
# 9. 可视化与输出
# =========================
ndsi_vis = {
    ""min"": 1,
    ""max"": 3,
    ""palette"": [
        ""#f0f0f0"",  # 弱积雪/无雪
        ""#9ecae1"",  # 过渡区
        ""#2171b5""   # 稳定积雪区
    ]
}

sensitive_vis = {
    ""min"": 0,
    ""max"": 1,
    ""palette"": [
        ""#d9d9d9"",
        ""#d73027""
    ]
}

ndsi_class.styles(ndsi_vis).getMap(""积雪分布结果"")
snow_sensitive_band.styles(sensitive_vis).getMap(""积雪敏感地形带结果"")

geo_res_dem.log(""高程因子积雪解释结果"")
geo_res_slope.log(""坡度因子积雪解释结果"")
geo_res_aspect.log(""坡向因子积雪解释结果"")
geo_res_position.log(""相对地形位置因子积雪解释结果"")

"T0069","spatial_analysis","zh","基于武汉市 2023 年交通设施数据，构造一条穿过城市主通道方向的简化走廊线，并围绕这条走廊建立缓冲区，筛查走廊范围内的公交站点。这个任务重点是用一个明确的线性空间约束，把主通道附近的公交设施提取出来，形成沿走廊分布的基础结果。","import oge

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service.initialize()

# =========================
# 1. 读取武汉市交通设施
# =========================
trans_2023 = service.getFeatureCollection(
    productId=""wuhan_trans_stations_2023"",
    crs=""EPSG:4326""
)

# =========================
# 2. 构造走廊线
# =========================
corridor_geom = service.getProcess(
    ""Geometry.LineString""
).execute(
    [
        [114.10, 30.45],
        [114.30, 30.58],
        [114.55, 30.72]
    ],
    ""EPSG:4326""
)

corridor_feature = service.getProcess(
    ""Feature.loadFromGeometry""
).execute(
    corridor_geom,
    {""name"": ""main_corridor""}
)

# =========================
# 3. 建立1000米缓冲区
# =========================
corridor_buffer = service.getProcess(
    ""Feature.buffer""
).execute(
    corridor_feature,
    1000,
    ""EPSG:4326""
)

# 将缓冲区Feature转换为FeatureCollection
corridor_fc = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList""
).execute(
    [corridor_buffer]
)

# 提取真正的缓冲区Geometry
corridor_buffer_geom = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.geometryGetAndMerge""
).execute(
    corridor_fc,
    ""geom""
)

# =========================
# 4. 筛选公交站
# =========================
bus_stop = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.filterMetadata""
).execute(
    trans_2023,
    ""fclass"",
    ""equals"",
    ""bus_stop""
)

# =========================
# 5. 筛选缓冲区内的公交站
# 使用filterBounds，不生成空的相交几何
# =========================
bus_in_corridor = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.filterBounds""
).execute(
    bus_stop,
    corridor_buffer_geom,
    ""geom""
)

# =========================
# 6. 输出数量，辅助检查
# =========================
bus_total_count = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.size""
).execute(bus_stop)

bus_corridor_count = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.size""
).execute(bus_in_corridor)

bus_total_count.log(""公交站总数"")
bus_corridor_count.log(""走廊内公交站数量"")

# =========================
# 7. 地图展示
# =========================
corridor_fc.styles(
    [""#FFF3A3""]
).getMap(""01_走廊1000米缓冲区"")

corridor_feature.styles(
    [""#0066FF""]
).getMap(""02_走廊中心线"")

    [""#808080""]
).getMap(""03_全部公交站"")

road_2023 = service.getFeatureCollection(
    productId=""wuhan_road_network_2023"",

)

    productId=""wuhan_trans_stations_2023"",
    crs=""EPSG:4326""
)

      [114.42, 30.53], [114.18, 30.53]]],
    ""EPSG:4326""
)
outer_geom = service.getProcess(""Geometry.Polygon"").execute(
    [[[114.02, 30.40], [114.02, 30.80], [114.60, 30.80],
      [114.60, 30.40], [114.02, 30.40]]],
    ""EPSG:4326""
)

core_feature = service.getProcess(""Feature.loadFromGeometry"").execute(
    core_geom,
    {""name"": ""core_area""}
)
outer_feature = service.getProcess(""Feature.loadFromGeometry"").execute(
    outer_geom,
    {""name"": ""outer_area""}
)

core_fc = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList"").execute(
    [core_feature]
)
outer_fc = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList"").execute(
    [outer_feature]
)

outer_only = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.difference"").execute(
    outer_fc,
    core_fc,
    ""geom"",
    ""geom""
)

outer_only_geom = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.geometryGetAndMerge""
).execute(
    outer_only,
    ""geom""
)

road_in_core = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.filterBounds"").execute(
    road_2023,
    core_geom,
    ""geom""

road_in_outer = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.filterBounds"").execute(

    outer_only_geom,

"T0075","spatial_analysis","zh","请基于武汉市 2023 年道路和交通设施数据，先人工构造两个部分重叠的分析区，提取它们的共享区、A 独有区和 B 独有区；然后叠加展示区域内的高等级道路骨架，并分别统计共享区、A 独有区和 B 独有区中的渡口设施分布情况，从而整理形成多区域重叠条件下的交通对象组织结果。","import oge

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# 1) 读取武汉市2023年道路与交通设施数据
road_2023 = service.getFeatureCollection(
    productId=""wuhan_road_network_2023"",
    crs=""EPSG:4326""
)
trans_2023 = service.getFeatureCollection(
    productId=""wuhan_trans_stations_2023"",
    crs=""EPSG:4326""
)

# 2) 构造两个部分重叠的分析区
zone_a_geom = service.getProcess(""Geometry.Polygon"").execute(
    [[[114.08, 30.48], [114.08, 30.72], [114.36, 30.72],
      [114.36, 30.48], [114.08, 30.48]]],
    ""EPSG:4326""
)
zone_b_geom = service.getProcess(""Geometry.Polygon"").execute(
    [[[114.24, 30.44], [114.24, 30.68], [114.56, 30.68],
      [114.56, 30.44], [114.24, 30.44]]],
    ""EPSG:4326""
)

zone_a_feature = service.getProcess(""Feature.loadFromGeometry"").execute(
    zone_a_geom,
    {""name"": ""zone_a""}
)
zone_b_feature = service.getProcess(""Feature.loadFromGeometry"").execute(
    zone_b_geom,
    {""name"": ""zone_b""}
)

zone_a_fc = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList"").execute(
    [zone_a_feature]
)
zone_b_fc = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList"").execute(
    [zone_b_feature]
)

# 3) 提取共享区、A独有区和B独有区
shared_zone = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.intersection"").execute(
    zone_a_fc,
    zone_b_fc
)
zone_a_only = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.difference"").execute(
    zone_a_fc,
    zone_b_fc,
    ""geom"",
    ""geom""
)
zone_b_only = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.difference"").execute(
    zone_b_fc,
    zone_a_fc,
    ""geom"",
    ""geom""
)

# 提取三个分区的Geometry，用于设施空间筛选
shared_geom = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.geometryGetAndMerge""
).execute(shared_zone, ""geom"")

zone_a_only_geom = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.geometryGetAndMerge""
).execute(zone_a_only, ""geom"")

zone_b_only_geom = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.geometryGetAndMerge""
).execute(zone_b_only, ""geom"")

# 4) 提取高等级道路骨架
motorway = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.filterMetadata"").execute(
    road_2023,
    ""fclass"",
    ""equals"",
    ""motorway""
)
primary = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.filterMetadata"").execute(
    road_2023,
    ""fclass"",
    ""equals"",
    ""primary""
)
road_skeleton = service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.merge"").execute(
    motorway,
    primary
)

# 5) 提取渡口设施
ferry_terminal = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.filterMetadata""
).execute(
    trans_2023,
    ""fclass"",
    ""equals"",
    ""ferry_terminal""
)

# 6) 按三个分区筛选渡口设施
ferry_shared = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.filterBounds""
).execute(
    ferry_terminal,
    shared_geom,
    ""geom""
)
ferry_a_only = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.filterBounds""
).execute(
    ferry_terminal,
    zone_a_only_geom,
    ""geom""
)
ferry_b_only = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.filterBounds""
).execute(
    ferry_terminal,
    zone_b_only_geom,
    ""geom""
)

# 7) 输出统计结果
service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.size"").execute(
    shared_zone
).log(""shared_zone_count"")

service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.size"").execute(
    zone_a_only
).log(""zone_a_only_count"")

service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.size"").execute(
    zone_b_only
).log(""zone_b_only_count"")

service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.size"").execute(
    road_skeleton
).log(""road_skeleton_total_count"")

service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.size"").execute(
    ferry_terminal
).log(""ferry_terminal_total_count"")

service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.size"").execute(
    ferry_shared
).log(""ferry_shared_count"")

service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.size"").execute(
    ferry_a_only
).log(""ferry_a_only_count"")

service.getProcess(""FeatureCollection.size"").execute(
    ferry_b_only
).log(""ferry_b_only_count"")

# 8) 地图展示
zone_a_only.styles([""#66CCFF""]).getMap(""A独有区"")
zone_b_only.styles([""#CCCCCC""]).getMap(""B独有区"")
shared_zone.styles([""#FFCC00""]).getMap(""重叠共享区"")

road_skeleton.styles([""#0055FF""]).getMap(""高等级道路骨架"")

ferry_a_only.styles([""#00AAFF""]).getMap(""A独有区渡口"")
ferry_b_only.styles([""#AA00FF""]).getMap(""B独有区渡口"")
ferry_shared.styles([""#FF0000""]).getMap(""共享区渡口"")

"T0084","spatial_analysis","zh","以武汉市中华路码头附近的沿江片区为背景，构造两条不同方向的支撑通道，一条代表沿江主通道，另一条代表向内陆连接的支撑通道，再以中华路 1 号码头这一真实关键节点建立排除带。任务结果需要给出支撑约束区 A、支撑约束区 B、双支撑同时满足的优先候选区、仅满足单一支撑的备用候选区，以及研究范围内不满足任一支撑条件的空白区，用于整理双支撑条件下的候选区优先级组织结果。","import oge

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service.initialize()

# 研究区
study_geom = service.getProcess(""Geometry.Polygon"").execute(
    [[[114.24, 30.52], [114.24, 30.59], [114.35, 30.59],
      [114.35, 30.52], [114.24, 30.52]]],
    ""EPSG:4326""
)
study = service.getProcess(""Feature.loadFromGeometry"").execute(
    study_geom, {""name"": ""study_area""}
)

# 支撑通道 A
support_a_geom = service.getProcess(""Geometry.LineString"").execute(
    [[114.245, 30.545], [114.29, 30.552], [114.34, 30.558]],
    ""EPSG:4326""
)
support_a = service.getProcess(""Feature.loadFromGeometry"").execute(
    support_a_geom, {""name"": ""support_a""}
)
support_a_buffer = service.getProcess(""Feature.buffer"").execute(
    support_a, 800, ""EPSG:4326""
)

# 支撑通道 B
support_b_geom = service.getProcess(""Geometry.LineString"").execute(
    [[114.275, 30.525], [114.29, 30.552], [114.315, 30.585]],
    ""EPSG:4326""
)
support_b = service.getProcess(""Feature.loadFromGeometry"").execute(
    support_b_geom, {""name"": ""support_b""}
)
support_b_buffer = service.getProcess(""Feature.buffer"").execute(
    support_b, 800, ""EPSG:4326""
)

# 关键节点排除带
key_geom = service.getProcess(""Geometry.Point"").execute(
    [114.2885828, 30.5512112],
    ""EPSG:4326""
)
key_node = service.getProcess(""Feature.loadFromGeometry"").execute(
    key_geom,
    {""name"": ""中华路1号码头"", ""fclass"": ""ferry_terminal""}
)
exclusion = service.getProcess(""Feature.buffer"").execute(
    key_node, 300, ""EPSG:4326""
)

# 将各约束范围裁到研究区
support_a_in = service.getProcess(""Feature.intersection"").execute(
    support_a_buffer, study, ""EPSG:4326""
)
support_b_in = service.getProcess(""Feature.intersection"").execute(
    support_b_buffer, study, ""EPSG:4326""
)
exclusion_in = service.getProcess(""Feature.intersection"").execute(
    exclusion, study, ""EPSG:4326""
)

# 双支撑优先区
priority_base = service.getProcess(""Feature.intersection"").execute(
    support_a_in, support_b_in, ""EPSG:4326""
)
priority_zone = service.getProcess(""Feature.difference"").execute(
    priority_base, exclusion_in, ""EPSG:4326""
)

# 仅满足单一支撑的备用区
backup_a = service.getProcess(""Feature.difference"").execute(
    support_a_in, support_b_in, ""EPSG:4326""
)
backup_b = service.getProcess(""Feature.difference"").execute(
    support_b_in, support_a_in, ""EPSG:4326""
)
backup_a = service.getProcess(""Feature.difference"").execute(
    backup_a, exclusion_in, ""EPSG:4326""
)
backup_b = service.getProcess(""Feature.difference"").execute(
    backup_b, exclusion_in, ""EPSG:4326""
)

backup_zone = service.getProcess(
    ""FeatureCollection.loadFromFeatureList""
).execute([backup_a, backup_b])

# 不满足任一支撑条件的空白区
blank_step = service.getProcess(""Feature.difference"").execute(
    study, support_a_in, ""EPSG:4326""
)
blank_zone = service.getProcess(""Feature.difference"").execute(
    blank_step, support_b_in, ""EPSG:4326""
)

"T0141","quantitative_remote_sensing","zh","请结合 NDVI 和地表温度数据计算温度植被干旱指数（TVDI），并把结果在地图上展示出来。","import oge

oge.initialize()
service = oge.Service()

# ============================================================
# 1. 读取Landsat Collection 2 Level-2数据
# ============================================================
landsat_l2 = service.getCoverage(
    coverageID=""LC09_L2SP_125023_20211031_20230507_02_T1"",
    productID=""LC09_C02_L2""
)

landsat_l2 = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.toFloat""
).execute(landsat_l2)

# ============================================================
# 2. 提取红光、近红外和地表温度波段
# 使用波段号：SR_B4、SR_B5、ST_B10
# ============================================================
red_dn = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.selectBands""
).execute(landsat_l2, [""SR_B4""])

nir_dn = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.selectBands""
).execute(landsat_l2, [""SR_B5""])

st_dn = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.selectBands""
).execute(landsat_l2, [""ST_B10""])

# ============================================================
# 3. Collection 2 Level-2地表反射率定标
#
# Reflectance = DN × 0.0000275 - 0.2
# ============================================================
red = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.multiplyNum""
).execute(red_dn, 0.0000275)

red = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.addNum""
).execute(red, -0.2)

nir = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.multiplyNum""
).execute(nir_dn, 0.0000275)

nir = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.addNum""
).execute(nir, -0.2)

# ============================================================
# 4. 使用定标后的反射率计算NDVI
#
# NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red)
#
# 由于反射率存在-0.2偏移，不能直接在原始DN上调用
# normalizedDifference，因此手动计算。
# ============================================================
ndvi_num = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.subtract""
).execute(nir, red)

ndvi_den = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.add""
).execute(nir, red)

ndvi = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.divide""
).execute(ndvi_num, ndvi_den)

# ============================================================
# 5. Collection 2 Level-2地表温度定标
#
# LST(K) = DN × 0.00341802 + 149
# LST(℃) = LST(K) - 273.15
# ============================================================
lst_k = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.multiplyNum""
).execute(st_dn, 0.00341802)

lst_k = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.addNum""
).execute(lst_k, 149.0)

lst_c = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.subtractNum""
).execute(lst_k, 273.15)

# ============================================================
# 6. 构造NDVI-LST湿边和干边
#
# 湿边：Twet = 25 - 10 × NDVI
# 干边：Tdry = 45 - 5 × NDVI
#
# 这些参数适合作为代码Demo参数。
# 定量研究时应从当前场景的NDVI-LST散点空间拟合。
# ============================================================
wet_edge = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.multiplyNum""
).execute(ndvi, -10.0)

wet_edge = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.addNum""
).execute(wet_edge, 25.0)

dry_edge = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.multiplyNum""
).execute(ndvi, -5.0)

dry_edge = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.addNum""
).execute(dry_edge, 45.0)

# ============================================================
# 7. 计算TVDI
#
# TVDI = (LST - Twet) / (Tdry - Twet)
# ============================================================
tvdi_num = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.subtract""
).execute(lst_c, wet_edge)

tvdi_den = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.subtract""
).execute(dry_edge, wet_edge)

tvdi = service.getProcess(
    ""Coverage.divide""
).execute(tvdi_num, tvdi_den)

# ============================================================
# 8. 地图展示
# ============================================================
tvdi_vis = {
    ""min"": 0,
    ""max"": 1,
    ""palette"": [

        ""#00ffff"",
        ""#00ff00"",
        ""#ffff00"",
        ""#ffa500"",
        ""#ff0000"",
        ""#800000""

}
